facts.sourceQuote: De campus is rechtstreeks bereikbaar vanuit het centrum van Rotterdam (Willemskade) met OV te water en een in 2008 geopende halte van de Aqualiner.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The campus is directly accessible from the center of Rotterdam (Willemskade) by water transport and a station opened in 2008 by the Aqualiner.

features.opening: De RDM Campus is een campus op het terrein van de voormalige Rotterdamsche Droogdok Maatschappij (RDM), midden in de Rotterdamse Stadshavens.

features.name: Il grande miracolo

facts.text: Marino Marini's sculpture replaced a simple memorial in 1955 to make way for new construction.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kunstwerk van Marino Marini werd in 1955 aangeschaft ter vervanging van een eenvoudig gedenkteken dichtbij, dat moest wijken voor nieuwbouw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The work of art by Marino Marini was purchased in 1955 to replace a simple memorial nearby, which had to make way for new construction.

facts.text: White concrete plates were added behind the horse and rider to increase visibility after it moved.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1988 werd het beeld verplaatst naar de andere kant van de Pleinweg. Daar werd het voorzien van een achtergrond van witte betonnen platen wat de zichtbaarheid vergroot.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1988, the statue was moved to the other side of the Pleinweg. It was then provided with a background of white concrete plates which increases visibility.

facts.text: The rearing horse throws off its rider specifically because of fear from an approaching bomb.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de twee haaks op elkaar staande wanden is een tekst aangebracht: 'VOOR DE ONGENOEMDEN DIE VIELEN VOOR DE VRIJHEID ONSTERFELIJK DOOR HET OFFER VAN HUN LEVEN' Het beeld bestaat uit een steigerend paard, dat uit angst voor een dichtbij inslaande bom, zijn berijder afwerpt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the two walls standing at right angles to each other is a text: 'FOR THE UNNAMED WHO MANY HAVE DIED FOR FREEDOM THROUGH THE OFFER OF THEIR LIVES' The image consists of a rearing horse, which throws off its rider out of fear of a bomb approaching.

features.opening: Il grande miracolo is een oorlogsmonument aan de Pleinweg in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam.

features.name: De Hoop

facts.text: Stone rollers inside date back to the fourteenth century for grinding grain.
facts.sourceQuote: De Hoop heeft een Oudhollands gevlucht en bevat 2 koppels 14der kunststenen voor het malen van graan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: De Hoop has an Old Dutch mill and contains 2 pairs of 14th century stone rollers for grinding grain.

facts.text: The ground floor now serves as a venue for weddings.
facts.sourceQuote: De benedenverdieping is te gebruiken als trouwlocatie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ground floor can be used as a wedding venue.

features.opening: Korenmolen De Hoop aan de Molenweg in Rozenburg werd in 1887 opgericht, ter vervanging van een uit 1658 stammende molen die was gelegen aan de binnenkant van…

features.name: De Boeg

facts.text: Princess Margriet unveiled the monument on April 10, 1957.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument van Fred Carasso werd op 10 april 1957 door prinses Margriet onthuld op de hoek van de Boompjes en de Leuvehaven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument of Fred Carasso was unveiled on April 10, 1957 by Princess Margriet on the corner of the Boompjes and the Leuvehaven.

facts.text: A bronze group featuring a rower, three sailors, and a drowned man was added in 1965.
facts.sourceQuote: Later, op 15 juli 1965 werd een 8 meter hoge bronzen beeldengroep aan het monument toegevoegd: een roerganger, drie zeelui en een verdronkene.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Later, on July 15, 1965, an 8-meter-high bronze sculpture group was added to the monument: a rower, three sailors and a drowned man.

features.opening: De Boeg is een oorlogsmonument in Rotterdam.

features.name: Christus Koning

facts.text: Lightning struck the tower in 1991, causing the spire to be demolished permanently.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1991 sloeg de bliksem in de kerktoren, die daarna dreigde in te storten. De spits werd daarom gesloopt en is daarna niet meer herbouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1991, lightning struck the church tower, which then threatened to collapse. The spire was therefore demolished and has not been rebuilt since then.

facts.text: Neighbors saved the church from demolition after the parish board initially wanted it destroyed.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd al in 1997 aangewezen als gemeentelijk monument, maar het parochiebestuur tekende beroep aan omdat men het gebouw wilde laten slopen. Buurtbewoners kwamen in actie om het kerkgebouw te behouden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was already designated as a municipal monument in 1997, but the parish board appealed because they wanted the building demolished. Neighbors took action to preserve the church building.

features.opening: De Christus Koningkerk is een voormalige rooms-katholieke kerk aan het Statenplein in Rotterdam.

features.name: Sint-Hildegardis & Sint-Antonius

facts.text: Sint-Hildegardis & Sint-Antonius was designed by Evert Margry, a key student of Pierre Cuyper.
facts.sourceQuote: The neo-Gothic cruciform church was built between 1890 and 1892 according to a design by the Rotterdam architect Evert Margry, one of the most important students of Pierre Cuyper.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The neo-Gothic cruciform church was built between 1890 and 1892 according to a design by the Rotterdam architect Evert Margry, one of the most important students of Pierre Cuyper.

features.opening: St Hildegard's Church (Dutch: Sint-Hildegardiskerk) is a Roman Catholic church in the Oude Noorden (in Hillegersberg, before the boundary changes of 1904) in…

features.name: Norwegian church

facts.text: King Haakon VII of newly independent Norway donated generously to fund its construction.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kerkje kon gebouwd worden dankzij talrijke giften, onder meer een ruime bijdrage van Koning Haakon VII van het juist onafhankelijk geworden Noorwegen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church could be built thanks to numerous donations, including a generous contribution from King Haakon VII of the newly independent Norway.

facts.text: A British incendiary bomb partially burned the living quarters in 1941 while sparing the church.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 3 oktober 1941 brandde het woongedeelte deels uit door een Britse brandbom; de dominee en zijn familie moesten een paar jaar elders verblijven, maar de schade kon worden hersteld. De kerkruimte zelf liep weinig schade op en kon in gebruik blijven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On October 3, 1941, the living quarters were partially burned out by a British incendiary bomb; the pastor and his family had to live elsewhere for a few years, but the damage could be repaired. The church space itself suffered little damage and could remain in use.

facts.text: The annex of Norwegian church hosts meetings for the Noorse community in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bijgebouw wordt gebruikt voor bijeenkomsten van de Noorse gemeenschap in Nederland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The annex is used for meetings of the Noorse community in the Netherlands.

features.opening: De Noorse Zeemanskerk (Sjømannskirken i Rotterdam) is een kerk in Rotterdam.

features.name: Arminiuskerk

facts.text: The municipality originally wanted the old site for fair expansion before a land exchange occurred.
facts.sourceQuote: De gemeente wilde het terrein van de oude kerk gebruiken voor een uitbreiding van de Beurs. Via een grondruil verkreeg de Remonstrantse gemeente in 1895 een kavel aan de Westersingel aan de rand van het onbebouwde Land van Hoboken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The municipality wanted to use the site of the old church for an expansion of the Fair. Through a land exchange, the Remonstrant Reformed Church obtained a plot on the Westersingel on the edge of the undeveloped Land of Hoboken in 1895.

facts.text: A glass mosaic above the entrance displays an angel flanked by the words Faith and Study, created by Parisian artist Facchina.
facts.sourceQuote: Boven de ingang is een groot tweelichtvenster en een glasmozaïek waarin een engel met een bijbel en aan weerszijden de woorden "Geloof" en "Onderzoek" ontworpen door de Parijse mozaïst Facchina.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Above the entrance is a large double-light window and a glass mosaic in which an angel with a Bible and on either side the words "Faith" and "Study" designed by the Parisian mosaicist Facchina.

facts.text: Until 1965, the forecourt was enclosed by a wrought iron fence featuring brick pillars topped with donkey backs.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot 1965 was het voorplein aan de Westersingel omheind met een smeedijzeren sierhekwerk tussen bakstenen pijlers met ezelsruggen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until 1965, the forecourt on the Westersingel was enclosed with a wrought iron ornamental fence between brick pillars with donkey backs.

features.opening: De Arminiuskerk of Remonstrantse Kerk aan de Westersingel te Rotterdam is als godshuis van de remonstranten gebouwd in 1895-1897.

features.name: Houweling Telecom Museum

facts.text: Former KPN employees volunteer to expand the collection and present its exhibits.
facts.sourceQuote: Een aantal enthousiaste oud-medewerkers van KPN werken aan de uitbouw van het museum en de presentatie van de collectie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A number of enthusiastic former KPN employees are working on the expansion of the museum and the presentation of the collection.

facts.text: Visitors can see working telephone exchanges alongside vintage measuring equipment.
facts.sourceQuote: Wat er allemaal in het museum te zien is: eindapparatuur die bij klanten gebruikt werd allerlei vormen en ontwikkelingen van telecommunicatie telefooncentrales in werking onderdelen kabelnet gereedschap en kleding meetapparatuur informatie over wijkcentrales en ISRA-punten beeldmateriaal documentatie enz.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: What is all on display in the museum: end equipment that was used by customers various forms and developments of telecommunications telephone exchanges in operation components cable network tools and clothing measuring equipment information about district exchanges and ISRA points video material documentation etc.

features.opening: Het Houweling Telecom Museum is in 1974 gestart en herbergt de geschiedenis op het gebied van telecommunicatie in de Zuid-Hollandse stad Rotterdam en de regio.

features.name: Forgotten Bombardment

facts.text: A memorial created by Mathieu Ficheroux was unveiled by Prime Minister Ruud Lubbers to honor those killed or maimed in the attack.
facts.sourceQuote: Gijzing Park contains a memorial in remembrance of those killed and maimed by the attack (the monument was created by Mathieu Ficheroux and was unveiled by Dutch Prime Minister Ruud Lubbers on 31 March 1993).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Gijzing Park contains a memorial in remembrance of those killed and maimed by the attack (the monument was created by Mathieu Ficheroux and was unveiled by Dutch Prime Minister Ruud Lubbers on 31 March 1993).

facts.text: The raid left between 10,000 and 20,000 people homeless after claiming between 326 and 401 lives in a single day.
facts.sourceQuote: The death toll was between 326 and 401 and made between 10,000 and 20,000 people homeless.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The death toll was between 326 and 401 and made between 10,000 and 20,000 people homeless.

facts.text: Local school lessons omitted this specific raid until the 1990s broke the silence.
facts.sourceQuote: Until the 1990s, the raid that took place on 31 March 1943 was not mentioned in local school history lessons about the region's war time experiences.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until the 1990s, the raid that took place on 31 March 1943 was not mentioned in local school history lessons about the region's war time experiences.

features.opening: During the German occupation of the Netherlands between 1940 and 1945, during the Second World War, Allied air forces carried out a number of operations over…

features.name: Theater Zuidplein

facts.text: The venue was originally named Groote Schouwburg to honor a vanished Rotterdam theater.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gebouw werd aanvankelijk 'Groote Schouwburg' genoemd als hommage aan verdwenen schouwburg van Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was initially called 'Groote Schouwburg' as a tribute to the vanished theater in Rotterdam.

facts.text: A 1978 renovation led to the building officially adopting the name Theater Zuidplein.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1978 kreeg het theater een grote verbouwing en kreeg het zijn huidige naam "Theater Zuidplein".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1978 the theater underwent a major renovation and was renamed "Theater Zuidplein".

facts.text: Architect Sybold van Ravesteyn designed the original structure built between 1946 and 1954.
facts.sourceQuote: Het eerste gebouw van Theater Zuidplein is gebouwd in de periode 1946-1954 naar een ontwerp van architect Sybold van Ravesteyn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first building of Theater Zuidplein was built in the period 1946-1954 according to a design by architect Sybold van Ravesteyn.

features.opening: Het Theater Zuidplein is een theater aan het Zuidplein in Rotterdam, nabij het Winkelcentrum Zuidplein.

features.name: Chabot Museum

facts.text: Neighbors include the Museum Boijmans van Beuningen and the Netherlands Architecture Institute.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum is housed in a monumental villa in the Museumpark, near the Museum Boijmans van Beuningen and the Netherlands Architecture Institute.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum is housed in a monumental villa in the Museumpark, near the Museum Boijmans van Beuningen and the Netherlands Architecture Institute.

facts.text: The white villa was built in the New Objectivity style by architects Gerrit Willem Baas and Leonard Stokla.
facts.sourceQuote: Kraaijeveld in the style of New Objectivity. The architects were Gerrit Willem Baas, a former employee of Brinkman and Van der Vlugt, and Leonard Stokla, a former bureau chief of Kromhout.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Kraaijeveld in the style of New Objectivity. The architects were Gerrit Willem Baas, a former employee of Brinkman and Van der Vlugt, and Leonard Stokla, a former bureau chief of Kromhout.

facts.text: Gerrit Willem Baas previously worked for Brinkman and Van der Vlugt before designing this home.
facts.sourceQuote: The architects were Gerrit Willem Baas, a former employee of Brinkman and Van der Vlugt, and Leonard Stokla, a former bureau chief of Kromhout.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architects were Gerrit Willem Baas, a former employee of Brinkman and Van der Vlugt, and Leonard Stokla, a former bureau chief of Kromhout.

features.opening: The Chabot Museum (Dutch pronunciation: [ɕaːˈbɔt myˈzeːjʏm]) is a museum dedicated to the Dutch painter and sculptor Hendrik (Henk) Chabot in Rotterdam in the…

features.name: Heilige Familie

facts.text: A three-key organ from the upper gallery was moved downstairs during renovation.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij deze verbouwing werd het fraaie drie-klaviersorgel van de bovengalerij naar beneden verplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During this renovation, the beautiful three-key organ from the upper gallery was moved downstairs.

facts.text: A 2016 plan to build a children's health center there was never realized.
facts.sourceQuote: In november 2016 werd bekendgemaakt dat het gebouw een nieuwe bestemming zou krijgen: er is toen aangekondigd dat er een gezondheidscentrum voor kinderen zou komen. Dit plan is niet gerealiseerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In November 2016, it was announced that the building would be given a new purpose: it was then announced that a children's health center would be built there. This plan has not been realized.

facts.text: August 2024 brought new plans to convert the site into a hotel and restaurant.
facts.sourceQuote: In augustus 2024 is een informatiebijeekomst aangekondigd [1] waarin plannen gepresenteerd zullen worden voor een ombouw tot hotel en restaurant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In August 2024, an information meeting was announced [1] in which plans will be presented for conversion into a hotel and restaurant.

facts.text: Similar conversions occurred in Utrecht's former Westerkerk and Amsterdam's Sint-Ritakerk.
facts.sourceQuote: Verwezen wordt naar soortgelijke projecten die gerealiseerd zijn in de voormalige Westerkerk (Utrecht) [2] en de voormalige Sint-Ritakerk (Amsterdam) [3]
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: References are made to similar projects that have been realized in the former Westerkerk (Utrecht) [2] and the former Sint-Ritakerk (Amsterdam) [3]

features.opening: De Heilige Familiekerk is een voormalige rooms-katholieke kerk aan de Nootdorpstraat in Rotterdam.

features.name: Monument 1940 - 1945

facts.text: The war memorial was officially unveiled on May 4, 1949.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument van Piet van den Eijnde (1896-1978) werd op 4 mei 1949 onthuld en bestaat uit een zuil waarop een vrouw is uitgebeeld, met een vogel bovenop haar linkerhand, als symbool van de vrijheid, en een knielende figuur aan haar rechterhand als symbool van het verslagen kwaad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument of Piet van den Eijnde (1896-1978) was unveiled on May 4, 1949 and consists of a column on which a woman is depicted, with a bird on top of her left hand, as a symbol of freedom, and a kneeling figure on her right hand as a symbol of the defeated evil.

facts.text: A bird perched on a woman's left hand symbolizes freedom in the sculpture.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument van Piet van den Eijnde (1896-1978) werd op 4 mei 1949 onthuld en bestaat uit een zuil waarop een vrouw is uitgebeeld, met een vogel bovenop haar linkerhand, als symbool van de vrijheid, en een knielende figuur aan haar rechterhand als symbool van het verslagen kwaad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument of Piet van den Eijnde (1896-1978) was unveiled on May 4, 1949 and consists of a column on which a woman is depicted, with a bird on top of her left hand, as a symbol of freedom, and a kneeling figure on her right hand as a symbol of the defeated evil.

facts.text: Inscriptions urge visitors to dedicate their deepest thoughts to those who gave everything for freedom.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan weerszijden van de zuil staat de tekst: "Wijdt dan het diepst van uw gedachtenis aan hen die voor uw vrijheid alles gaven".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On either side of the pillar is the text: "Then dedicate the deepest of your thoughts to those who gave everything for your freedom".

features.opening: Monument 1940 - 1945 is een oorlogsmonument in Oud-IJsselmonde, Rotterdam ter gedachtenis aan de Tweede Wereldoorlog.

features.name: Floating FARM

facts.text: The Floating FARM processes all raw dairy into fresh milk and yoghurt directly on-site.
facts.sourceQuote: All raw dairy is processed onsite into fresh milk and yoghurt and distributed inside the city.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: All raw dairy is processed onsite into fresh milk and yoghurt and distributed inside the city.

facts.text: The Floating FARM opened on May 13, 2019 with an initial herd of thirty-two cows.
facts.sourceQuote: Founded by Peter and Minke van Wingerden, the Floating Farm opened on May 13, 2019 with 32 cows, with the plan to grow to 40 cows in the future.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Founded by Peter and Minke van Wingerden, the Floating Farm opened on May 13, 2019 with 32 cows, with the plan to grow to 40 cows in the future.

facts.text: The farm feeds cows with city grass and food waste while returning fresh milk directly to the urban population.
facts.sourceQuote: To support growing cities, Floating Farm is designed to use residual products, such as grass from public parks and food waste, produced by the city, to feed the animals and give fresh milk back to the city.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: To support growing cities, Floating Farm is designed to use residual products, such as grass from public parks and food waste, produced by the city, to feed the animals and give fresh milk back to the city.

facts.text: Solar panels power the entire operation, and rainwater is harvested from the roof for use on site.
facts.sourceQuote: All of its power is sourced from solar energy panels, and rainwater is collected on the structure's roof.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: All of its power is sourced from solar energy panels, and rainwater is collected on the structure's roof.

facts.text: Automated systems handle milking, feeding, and manure cleanup without constant human intervention.
facts.sourceQuote: The farm also utilizes many automated processes, such as automated milking, manure cleanup, and feeding.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The farm also utilizes many automated processes, such as automated milking, manure cleanup, and feeding.

features.opening: Floating Farm is a floating dairy farm, described by its founders as the world's first, located in the harbour of Rotterdam.

features.name: Wereldmuseum Rotterdam

facts.text: Founded in 1883, the institution displays over 1800 ethnographic objects from diverse global cultures.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was founded in 1883 and shows more than 1800 ethnographic objects from various cultures in Asia, Oceania, Africa, the Americas and the Islamic heritage.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was founded in 1883 and shows more than 1800 ethnographic objects from various cultures in Asia, Oceania, Africa, the Americas and the Islamic heritage.

features.opening: The Wereldmuseum Rotterdam (formerly known as the Museum voor Land- en Volkenkunde) is an ethnographic museum, situated at Willemskade in Rotterdam, the…

features.name: Natuurhistorisch Museum Rotterdam

facts.text: The Natuurhistorisch Museum Rotterdam opened its doors in 1927.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1927, the Natuurhistorisch Museum (Natural History Museum) opened.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1927, the Natuurhistorisch Museum (Natural History Museum) opened.

facts.text: In 2015, exactly 44,009 visitors explored the museum's collections.
facts.sourceQuote: It had 44,009 visitors in 2015.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It had 44,009 visitors in 2015.

features.opening: The Natuurhistorisch Museum Rotterdam (Dutch pronunciation: [naːˈtyːrɦɪsˌtoːris myˈzeːjʏm ˌrɔtərˈdɑm]; English: Natural History Museum Rotterdam) is a natural…

features.name: Hoflaankerk

facts.text: The new church opened on December 26, 1842, the day after its predecessor closed.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 25 december 1842, 1e kerstdag, werd de laatste dienst gehouden in het oude kerkje aan de Veenweg en de volgende dag werd de nieuwe Hoflaankerk in gebruik genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On December 25, 1842, on the 1st day of Christmas, the last service was held in the old church on the Veenweg and the next day the new Hoflaankerk was put into use.

facts.text: Arend Roodenburg, a civil engineering head teacher, designed this structure.
facts.sourceQuote: De architect was Arend Roodenburg, hoofdonderwijzer Bouwkunde aan de koninklijke academie in Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architect was Arend Roodenburg, head teacher of Civil Engineering at the Royal Academy in The Hague.

facts.text: After 1940 bombings, the building housed the Rotte's Mannenkoor singing association for years.
facts.sourceQuote: Na het bombardement in 1940 diende het kerkgebouw lange tijd als het onderkomen voor Zangvereeniging Rotte's Mannenkoor.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the bombing in 1940, the church building served for a long time as the home of the Singing Association Rotte's Mannenkoor.

facts.text: The garden holds a replica of the oldest ANWB traffic sign pointing to Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: In de tuin staat een replica van het oudste ANWB-verkeersbord van Nederland, een wegwijzer richting Rotterdam 4 km naar het westen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the garden there is a replica of the oldest ANWB traffic sign in the Netherlands, a road sign pointing towards Rotterdam 4 km to the west.

features.opening: De Hoflaankerk op de hoek van de Hoflaan en de Oudedijk is het oudste kerkgebouw in de Rotterdamse wijk Kralingen.

features.name: Sonneveld House

facts.text: The kitchen became the first assembled from industrial modules after a 1938 update.
facts.sourceQuote: Met één uitzondering: al in 1938 werd het keukeninterieur uitgewisseld, omdat Bruynzeel dat jaar de baanbrekende, door Piet Zwart ontworpen keuken op de markt bracht, en deze onmiddellijk aan het state of the art interieur van Huis Sonneveld werd toegevoegd. Het was de eerste, uit industrieel vervaardigde modules samen te stellen keuken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With one exception: already in 1938, the kitchen interior was replaced, because Bruynzeel introduced the groundbreaking kitchen designed by Piet Zwart on the market that year, and this was immediately added to Huis Sonneveld's state-of-the-art interior. It was the first kitchen to be assembled from industrial-made modules.

facts.text: Living room sofas were adapted Le Corbusier designs manufactured by Allan & Co.
facts.sourceQuote: De grote bank in de huiskamer was gebaseerd op een ontwerp uit 1928 van Le Corbusier (uit de ontwerpreeks LC2 "fauteuil Grand Comfort"), maar aangepast door Van der Vlugt en vervaardigd door Allan & Co´s Koninklijke Nederlandsche Fabrieken van Meubelen en Spoorwegmaterieel N.V., die ook al het interieurtimmerwerk voor hun rekening namen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The large sofa in the living room was based on a design from 1928 by Le Corbusier (from the LC2 design series "fauteuil Grand Comfort"), but adapted by Van der Vlugt and manufactured by Allan & Co's Koninklijke Nederlandsche Fabrieken van Meubelen en Spoorwegmaterieel N.V., which also took care of all the interior carpentry for them.

facts.text: The interior and garden form a Gesamtkunstwerk tuned to the building's functional layout.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ontwerp van het interieur, de uitvoering van het timmerwerk, de keuze van stoffering en meubilair alsmede het ontwerp van de buitenruimte zijn tot in detail afgestemd op de functionele inrichting van het gebouw. Zodoende is er sprake van een Gesamtkunstwerk in de zin van het Dessauer Bauhaus van Walter Gropius.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design of the interior, the execution of the carpentry, the choice of upholstery and furniture as well as the design of the outdoor space are finely tuned to the functional layout of the building. Thus, there is a Gesamtkunstwerk in the sense of Walter Gropius' Dessauer Bauhaus.

features.opening: Huis Sonneveld in de Zuid-Hollandse stad Rotterdam is tussen 1932 en 1933 gebouwd door architect Leendert van der Vlugt van Bureau Brinkman & van der Vlugt in…

features.name: Stoomdepot SSN

facts.text: Visitors can view a large collection of steam locomotives from Germany and the Netherlands inside the engine shed.
facts.sourceQuote: In the museum's engine shed, a large collection of steam locomotives from Germany and the Netherlands may be viewed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the museum's engine shed, a large collection of steam locomotives from Germany and the Netherlands may be viewed.

features.opening: The Stoom Stichting Nederland (SSN) is a railway museum in Rotterdam, Netherlands, founded in 1976.

features.name: Hervormde Adriaen Janszkerk

facts.text: The Hervormde Adriaen Janszkerk is named after pastor Adriaen Jansz van Berckenwoude who began preaching Reformed doctrine in 1566.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk is vernoemd naar pastoor Adriaen Jansz van Berckenwoude die in 1566 breekt met de katholieke traditie en voortaan de hervormde leer preekt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church is named after pastor Adriaen Jansz van Berckenwoude who broke with the Catholic tradition in 1566 and from now on preaches the Reformed doctrine.

facts.text: A lightning strike in 1678 caused a fire that destroyed almost all church archives.
facts.sourceQuote: De bliksem trof de kerk in 1678, er was grote schade door de brand, ook gingen vrijwel alle archieven verloren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was struck by lightning in 1678, there was great damage due to the fire, almost all the archives were also lost.

facts.text: The interior features a monumental organ built by Van den Haspel, Schölgens & Van der Weyde in 1868.
facts.sourceQuote: In de kerk staat een monumentaal orgel van de Rotterdamse orgelmakers Van den Haspel, Schölgens & Van der Weyde, gebouwd in 1868.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the church stands a monumental organ by the Rotterdam organ makers Van den Haspel, Schölgens & Van der Weyde, built in 1868.

features.opening: De Adriaen Janszkerk is een Nederlandse kerk in IJsselmonde, een stadsdeel van Rotterdam.

features.name: Stadsgraanzuiger 19

facts.text: Stadsgraanzuiger 19 was purchased in Antwerp and towed to Rotterdam in May 1985.
facts.sourceQuote: Maar ook die stichting kon niet alle onderdelen restaureren en men vond in de zoektocht naar vervanging in Antwerpen de 'Stadsgraanzuiger No.19'. Men vond ook de middelen om het schip te kopen en in mei 1985 kon het naar Rotterdam worden versleept.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: But even that foundation could not restore all the parts and in the search for a replacement in Antwerp they found the 'Stadsgraanzuiger No.19'. The means to buy the ship were also found and in May 1985 it could be towed to Rotterdam.

facts.text: Two steam-powered vacuum pumps sit atop a steel pontoon to create suction for lifting light materials like coconut husks.
facts.sourceQuote: Het schip bestaat uit een ponton met een stalen constructie, waarin bovenin twee stoomaangedreven vacuümpompen staan, een groot rond vat (de recipiënt), waarin door de pompen een onderdruk wordt opgewekt, en daaronder een weegschaal. Met die onderdruk werd door middel van verstelbare zuigbuizen graan en derivaten, tapioca, maniok, soja- en cocosschroot en dergelijk licht materiaal uit zeeschepen opgezogen en na weging overgeslagen in coasters en binnenschepen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ship consists of a pontoon with a steel construction, in which two steam-powered vacuum pumps are located at the top, a large round tank (the receptacle), in which a vacuum is created by the pumps, and below it a weighing scale. With that pressurization, grain and derivatives, tapioca, cassava, soybean and coconut husks and such light material from ships were sucked up using adjustable suction hoses and, after weighing, transferred to coasters and inland vessels.

features.opening: Stadsgraanzuiger No.19 is een Antwerpse graanelevator die eigendom is van het Maritiem Museum te Rotterdam.

features.name: Cinerama

facts.text: The venue opened in July 1960 on the site of a bankrupt cinema that lasted only three years.
facts.sourceQuote: Cinerama was opened in July 1960, occupying the site of the former Scala cinema, which had gone bankrupt after just three years.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Cinerama was opened in July 1960, occupying the site of the former Scala cinema, which had gone bankrupt after just three years.

facts.text: Cinerama derived its name directly from the specific projection system it utilized.
facts.sourceQuote: It was named after the Cinerama projection system.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was named after the Cinerama projection system.

facts.text: The venue opened in 1960 before undergoing a major reconstruction during the 1980s.
facts.sourceQuote: It started in 1960 and was rebuilt in the 1980s.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It started in 1960 and was rebuilt in the 1980s.

facts.text: Beyond standard films, it hosts specialized events like the Arab Cinema and Wildlife Film Festival.
facts.sourceQuote: It also hosts a variety of festival screenings such as Arab Cinema, IFFR and the Wildlife Film Festival.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It also hosts a variety of festival screenings such as Arab Cinema, IFFR and the Wildlife Film Festival.

facts.text: The facility operates seven distinct screens under the ownership of the Kinepolis Group.
facts.sourceQuote: It has seven screens and is owned by the Kinepolis Group.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It has seven screens and is owned by the Kinepolis Group.

features.opening: Cinerama is a cinema in central Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

features.name: RiF010

facts.text: Rotterdam became the first city globally to host an urban surf pool in its center.
facts.sourceQuote: Door RiF010 is Rotterdam de eerste stad ter wereld met een 'urban surfpool', waar men kan surfen midden in de stad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Thanks to RiF010, Rotterdam is the first city in the world with an 'urban surf pool', where you can surf in the middle of the city.

facts.text: Eight engines pump water downward to create two distinct waves of different heights.
facts.sourceQuote: Een luchtdruksysteem met acht motoren die het water met kracht omlaag pompen zorgt ervoor dat kunstmatige golven breken. Dat systeem, gecombineerd met diepteverschillen in de bodem, maakt dat in het waterbassin twee keer golven breken: de eerste golf is 1,5 meter hoog, de tweede een halve meter.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: An air pressure system with eight engines that pump the water down with force ensures that artificial waves break. That system, combined with differences in depth in the soil, causes two waves to break in the water basin: the first wave is 1.5 meters high, the second half a meter.

facts.text: The annual Rotterdam Surf Open returns after a successful inaugural competition in 2024.
facts.sourceQuote: De officiële opening was op 6 juli 2024, met een surffestival en een surfwedstrijd.Deze surfwedstrijd, de Rotterdam Surf Open, keert na een succesvolle eerste editie jaarlijks terug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The official opening was on July 6, 2024, with a surfing festival and a surfing competition. This surfing competition, the Rotterdam Surf Open, will return annually after a successful first edition.

facts.text: A non-profit foundation manages profits to fund cultural events and youth water sports access.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gebied wordt beheerd door een gelijknamige non-profit stichting, die eventuele winst besteedt aan culturele en sportevenementen, en het bereikbaar maken van watersport voor de jeugd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The area is managed by a non-profit foundation of the same name, which spends any profits on cultural and sporting events, and making water sports accessible to young people.

facts.text: Former filmmaker Edwin van Viegen initiated the project and received three million euros to realize his vision.
facts.sourceQuote: Initiatiefnemer Edwin van Viegen, een voormalig filmmaker, kreeg een bedrag van 3 miljoen euro toebedeeld om zijn droom werkelijkheid te maken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Initiator Edwin van Viegen, a former filmmaker, was awarded an amount of 3 million euros to make his dream come true.

facts.text: Water finally began flowing into the basin on May 6, 2024, when Van Viegen's daughter turned on the tap.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 6 mei 2024 draaide de dochter van Van Viegen de waterkraan open, en sinds dat moment stroomt er water in het bassin.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 6, 2024, Van Viegen's daughter turned on the water tap, and since then water has been flowing into the basin.

features.opening: RiF010 is een kunstmatig watersportgebied met waterbassin in en om de Steigersgracht, in hartje Rotterdam.

features.name: Kids Marina

facts.text: Children as young as three can independently pilot police, fire, or rainbow boats.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bijzondere is, dat zo'n politieboot, brandweerboot, containerboot, havendienstvaartuig of zelfs een regenboogboot zelfstandig gevaren mag worden door kinderen vanaf drie jaar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The special thing is that such a police boat, fire brigade boat, container boat, harbor service vessel or even a rainbow boat may be operated independently by children from three years of age.

facts.text: A life jacket is mandatory for everyone regardless of how nice the weather appears.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is noodzaak dat er een reddingsvest wordt gedragen, zelfs bij mooi weer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is necessary to wear a life jacket, even on nice weather.

facts.text: Dedicated harbor masters provide permanent supervision and explain all procedures beforehand.
facts.sourceQuote: Er is permanent toezicht in de vorm van eigen havenmeesters, die voorafgaand aan de vaartocht alles uitlegt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is permanent supervision in the form of own harbor masters, who explain everything in advance of the voyage.

features.opening: Kids Marina is een kinderhaven waar elektrische bootjes varen in het hart van Rotterdam.

features.name: Pauluskerk

facts.text: The original Pauluskerk opened in 1960 and was demolished in 2007.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste Pauluskerk daar werd in 1960 in gebruik genomen door de hervormde gemeente Rotterdam (thans onderdeel van de Protestantse Kerk in Nederland) en werd in 2007 gesloopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first Pauluskerk there was put into use in 1960 by the Reformed Municipality of Rotterdam (now part of the Protestant Church in the Netherlands) and was demolished in 2007.

facts.text: A new futuristic Pauluskerk designed by English architect Will Alsop opened in 2013.
facts.sourceQuote: Op dezelfde plaats hervatte men in 2013 de kerkelijke activiteiten in een nieuw futuristisch ogend bouwwerk, een ontwerp van de Engelse architect Will Alsop.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2013, church activities resumed in the same place in a new futuristic-looking building, a design by the English architect Will Alsop.

facts.text: Since 1980, it transformed into a sanctuary for drug addicts, homeless people, and refugees.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd vooral bekend vanwege de opvang van mensen van de onderkant van de samenleving, waaronder drugsverslaafden, dak-en thuislozen en vluchtelingen, waar vanaf 1980 - onder leiding van dominee Hans Visser en zijn opvolger Dick Couvée - de kerk meer en meer een centrum voor werd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church became especially well-known for its reception of people from the bottom of society, including drug addicts, homeless and refugees, where from 1980 onwards - under the leadership of Reverend Hans Visser and his successor Dick Couvée - the church increasingly became a center for.

facts.text: Reverend Hans Visser led this shift toward social outreach before being succeeded by Dick Couvée.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd vooral bekend vanwege de opvang van mensen van de onderkant van de samenleving, waaronder drugsverslaafden, dak-en thuislozen en vluchtelingen, waar vanaf 1980 - onder leiding van dominee Hans Visser en zijn opvolger Dick Couvée - de kerk meer en meer een centrum voor werd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church became especially well-known for its reception of people from the bottom of society, including drug addicts, homeless and refugees, where from 1980 onwards - under the leadership of Reverend Hans Visser and his successor Dick Couvée - the church increasingly became a center for.

features.opening: Pauluskerk is een kerkgebouw aan de Mauritsweg in het centrum van Rotterdam.

features.name: Market Hall

facts.text: Architectural firm MVRDV designed the Market Hall's distinctive horseshoe shape.
facts.sourceQuote: The Markthal was designed by architectural firm MVRDV. The grey nature stone building has an archwise structure like a horseshoe.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Markthal was designed by architectural firm MVRDV. The grey nature stone building has an archwise structure like a horseshoe.

facts.text: Queen Máxima officially opened the complex on October 1, 2014.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was opened on October 1, 2014, by Queen Máxima of the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was opened on October 1, 2014, by Queen Máxima of the Netherlands.

facts.text: An underground garage holds over 1,200 cars across four stories.
facts.sourceQuote: Besides the large market hall, the complex houses 228 apartments, 4,600 m2 retail space, 1,600 m2 horeca and an underground 4-story parking garage with a capacity of over 1200 cars.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Besides the large market hall, the complex houses 228 apartments, 4,600 m2 retail space, 1,600 m2 horeca and an underground 4-story parking garage with a capacity of over 1200 cars.

features.opening: The Markthal (English: Market Hall) is a residential and office building with a market hall underneath, located in Rotterdam.

features.name: Euromast

facts.text: Dutch architect Hugh Maaskant designed this concrete structure between 1958 and 1960.
facts.sourceQuote: Euromast is an observation tower in Rotterdam, Netherlands, designed by Hugh Maaskant constructed between 1958 and 1960.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Euromast is an observation tower in Rotterdam, Netherlands, designed by Hugh Maaskant constructed between 1958 and 1960.

features.opening: Euromast is an observation tower in Rotterdam, Netherlands, designed by Hugh Maaskant constructed between 1958 and 1960.

features.name: Egbertus

facts.text: The original wooden church was moved in 1905 and destroyed during wartime actions in 1944.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1905 werd dit gebouw verplaatst naar de Rietdijkstraat, waar het bij oorlogshandelingen in 1944 werd verwoest.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1905, this building was moved to Rietdijkstraat, where it was destroyed in wartime actions in 1944.

facts.text: A small Marian chapel added in 2006 was designed by Vincent van Leent.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2006 werd een kleine Mariakapel toegevoegd, ontworpen door Vincent van Leent.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2006, a small Marian chapel was added, designed by Vincent van Leent.

facts.text: The facade features a sculpture of De Heilige Egbertus created by Albert Termote.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeldhouwwerk van De Heilige Egbertus op de voorgevel werd gemaakt door Albert Termote.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The sculpture of De Heilige Egbertus on the facade was made by Albert Termote.

features.opening: De Heilige Egbertuskerk is een rooms-katholieke kerk aan De Cordesstraat 27- 29 in Hoek van Holland.

features.name: Grote of Sint-Laurenskerk

facts.text: A wooden spire designed by Hendrick de Keyser was demolished in 1645 due to poor wood quality.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1621 a wooden spire was added to the tower, designed by Hendrick de Keyser. Poor quality of its wood caused the spire to be demolished in 1645.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1621 a wooden spire was added to the tower, designed by Hendrick de Keyser. Poor quality of its wood caused the spire to be demolished in 1645.

facts.text: The tower stood straight again in 1655 after new piles were driven under its foundation.
facts.sourceQuote: A stone cube was added to the tower, though it proved too heavy for the foundation in 1650. New piles were driven under the tower and in 1655 the tower stood straight again.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A stone cube was added to the tower, though it proved too heavy for the foundation in 1650. New piles were driven under the tower and in 1655 the tower stood straight again.

facts.text: Queen Wilhelmina stopped calls to demolish the church after it was heavily damaged in the 1940 Rotterdam Blitz.
facts.sourceQuote: In the Rotterdam Blitz on May 14, 1940, the Laurenskerk was heavily damaged, with only the tower and walls surviving. At first there were calls to demolish the church, but that was stopped by Queen Wilhelmina.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the Rotterdam Blitz on May 14, 1940, the Laurenskerk was heavily damaged, with only the tower and walls surviving. At first there were calls to demolish the church, but that was stopped by Queen Wilhelmina.

features.name: Boezemsingelkerk

facts.text: The original church opened on March 31, 1901 before being demolished in 2018.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerdere kerk werd geopend op 31 maart 1901. In verband met teruglopend kerkbezoek en de slechte bouwkundige staat werd deze oude kerk gesloopt in 2018.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The previous church was opened on March 31, 1901. Due to declining church attendance and the poor state of disrepair, this old church was demolished in 2018.

facts.text: Since 1927, a theological school library and board meetings have operated within its walls.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 13 januari 1927 is er naast de kerk de Theologische School van de Gereformeerde Gemeenten met bibliotheek gevestigd. Het curatorium van de Theologische School houdt er de vergaderingen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since January 13, 1927, in addition to the church, the Theological School of the Reformed Churches with library has been located. The board of directors of the Theological School holds the meetings there.

facts.text: In 2015, the interior was significantly reduced to accommodate only a few dozen weekly visitors.
facts.sourceQuote: Anno 2015 kwamen er per zondag nog enkele tientallen kerkgangers naar het gebouw en was het gebouw om die reden fors verkleind.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2015, a few dozen churchgoers still came to the building every Sunday and the building was therefore significantly reduced in size for that reason.

features.opening: De Boezemsingelkerk is een kerkgebouw van de Gereformeerde Gemeenten aan de Boezemsingel in het centrum van Rotterdam.

features.name: Sint-Bavo

facts.text: An emergency church on Rollostraat served the community starting in 1955.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1955 werd een noodkerk in gebruik genomen aan de Rollostraat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1955, an emergency church was put into use on Rollostraat.

facts.text: The current Sint-Bavo building opened for use in 1960 on the Slinge.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1960 kon het huidige kerkgebouw aan de Slinge in gebruik worden genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1960, the current church building on the Slinge could be put into use.

facts.text: Since 2012, the parish has belonged to the Parish Federation Maria Magdalena.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2012 maakt de parochie deel uit van de 'Parochiefederatie Maria Magdalena'.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2012, the parish has been part of the 'Parish Federation Maria Magdalena'.

features.opening: De Sint-Bavokerk is een rooms-katholieke parochiekerk in de Rotterdamse wijk Pendrecht.

features.name: Stadswerf Koningspoort

facts.text: Five tilt wagons lift up to 150 tons, while a historical crane handles loads of 1250 kg.
facts.sourceQuote: De vijf hellingwagens kunnen een totaalgewicht van 150 ton omhoog brengen. Voor hijswerk tot 1250 kg is de - eveneens historische - werfkraan beschikbaar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The five tilt wagons can lift a total weight of 150 tons. For lifting work up to 1250 kg, the - also historical - workshop crane is available.

features.opening: De scheepshelling Koningspoort is een museale scheepshelling die in 1983 is gebouwd op de plaats waar vroeger de doorgang was van de Maas naar de Oude Haven…

features.name: Maritime Museum

facts.text: The institution was established in 1874 by Prince Henry of the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: Dedicated to naval history, it was founded in 1874 by Prince Henry of the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Dedicated to naval history, it was founded in 1874 by Prince Henry of the Netherlands.

facts.text: Historic vessels and cranes within the harbour are kept in working condition.
facts.sourceQuote: The Maritime Museum Harbour contains a collection of historic vessels and cranes which are maintained in working condition.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Maritime Museum Harbour contains a collection of historic vessels and cranes which are maintained in working condition.

facts.text: The collection holds 850,000 objects spanning six centuries of maritime history.
facts.sourceQuote: The Museum Collection contains 850,000 objects from six centuries of maritime history.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Museum Collection contains 850,000 objects from six centuries of maritime history.

facts.text: Permanent and rotating displays are specifically designed for children, parents, and grandparents.
facts.sourceQuote: The Maritime Museum includes both permanent and changing exhibitions designed for three generations: children, their parents and grandparents.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Maritime Museum includes both permanent and changing exhibitions designed for three generations: children, their parents and grandparents.

features.opening: The Maritime Museum Rotterdam is a maritime museum in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

features.name: Vierkant eiland in de plas

facts.text: Frans de Wit from Leiden created this large monumental artwork.
facts.sourceQuote: Vierkant eiland in de plas is een groot monumentaal kunstwerk gemaakt door kunstenaar Frans de Wit (Leiden, 1942-2004).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Vierkant eiland in de plas is a large monumental work of art made by artist Frans de Wit (Leiden, 1942-2004).

facts.text: The piece was officially unveiled on October 2, 1996.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kunstwerk is onthuld op 2 oktober 1996.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The artwork was unveiled on October 2, 1996.

facts.text: A deep concrete shell with a 28.5-meter diameter sits on a 52-by-52-meter square base.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is een kunstmatig eiland van 52 × 52 meter, bestaande uit een diepe betonnen schaal met een diameter van 28,5 meter op een vierkante basis, met rondom oplopende balken die 7,15 meter boven de waterspiegel uitsteken en op ongeveer gelijke hoogte uitkomen van het NAP.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is an artificial island of 52 × 52 meters, consisting of a deep concrete shell with a diameter of 28.5 meters on a square base, with rising beams around it that protrude 7.15 meters above sea level and meet at approximately the same height as sea level.

facts.text: Two bridge sections connect this artificial island to the surrounding shores.
facts.sourceQuote: Het eiland is met twee brugdelen verbonden met de oevers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The island is connected to the shores by two bridge sections.

features.opening: Vierkant eiland in de plas is een groot monumentaal kunstwerk gemaakt door kunstenaar Frans de Wit (Leiden, 1942-2004).

features.name: Oude Kerk Charlois

facts.text: A pastor and church were already present in Charlois by 1467 when it joined the Schieland deanery.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste kerk moet voor 1467 klaar geweest zijn. In dat jaar was Charlois reeds ingedeeld bij het decanaat Schieland, wat er op wijst dat er een pastoor met een kerk was.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first church must have been ready by 1467. In that year, Charlois had already been assigned to the Schieland deanery, which indicates that there was a pastor with a church.

facts.text: The tower was completed in 1660, predating the main hall built in 1868.
facts.sourceQuote: De huidige kerkzaal dateert van 1868. De toren kwam al in 1660 gereed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current church hall dates from 1868. The tower was ready as early as 1660.

features.opening: De Oude Kerk is een kerk in het Rotterdamse stadsdeel Charlois.

features.name: Havendienst 20

facts.text: Oral tradition claims the shipyard saved Havendienst 20 from dismantling during World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: De mondelinge overlevering leert dat men op de werf kans heeft gezien de boot gedurende de Tweede Wereldoorlog nooit af te bouwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The oral tradition teaches that on the shipyard there was a chance to never dismantle the ship during World War II.

facts.text: The intended owner could not afford the boat, so Rotterdam's harbor service bought it in 1950.
facts.sourceQuote: Na de oorlog had de beoogde eigenaar onvoldoende middelen om de boot van de werf te kunnen afnemen. Door bemiddeling van scheepsmakelaar Van Veen werd in 1950 het Havenbedrijf der Gemeente Rotterdam de nieuwe eigenaar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the war, the intended owner had insufficient funds to take the boat off the shipyard. Through the mediation of shipbroker Van Veen, in 1950 the Havenbedrijf der Gemeente Rotterdam became the new owner.

facts.text: Havendienst 20 served as an icebreaker after being converted for firefighting in 1955.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1955 is het schip verbouwd tot brandblus-boot en in 1963 is het schip geschikt gemaakt als ijsbreker.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1955 the ship was converted into a firefighting boat and in 1963 the ship was adapted as an icebreaker.

facts.text: A 150 hp three-cylinder diesel engine originally powered the vessel.
facts.sourceQuote: Oorspronkelijk was de boot voorzien van een 3-cilinder Brons 2-takt dieselmotor van 150pk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally, the boat was equipped with a 3-cylinder Bronze 2-stroke diesel engine of 150 hp.

features.opening: De Havendienst 20 is in 1939 als sleepboot voor een particulier op stapel gezet aan de Roode Vaart bij de werf Gebroeders Paans in Moerdijk.

facts.text: Engineer Pieter Caland designed the Nieuwe Waterweg, which this monument commemorates.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Calandmonument in het Scheepvaartkwartier, in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam, gedenkt ingenieur Pieter Caland, die de Nieuwe Waterweg, de directe verbinding met zee, ontwierp.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Calandmonument in the Shipping Quarter, in the Dutch city of Rotterdam, commemorates engineer Pieter Caland, who designed the Nieuwe Waterweg, the direct connection to the sea.

facts.text: Two bronze children figures represent the trade and industry of Rotterdam as a trading place.
facts.sourceQuote: Twee bronzen kinderfiguren symboliseren de handel en nijverheid van Rotterdam als handelsplaats.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Two bronze children's figures symbolize the trade and industry of Rotterdam as a trading place.

facts.text: Rotterdam city architect Pieter Adams designed this structure with government financial support.
facts.sourceQuote: Met financiële steun van de overheid werd een waterstaatskerk in neoclassicistische stijl gebouwd, naar een ontwerp van de Rotterdamse stadsarchitect Pieter Adams.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With financial support from the government, a neoclassical-style waterworks church was built, according to a design by Rotterdam city architect Pieter Adams.

facts.text: The entrance features a Greek temple façade with two Doric columns flanking the doorway.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk heeft een typerende entree in de vorm van de façade van een Griekse tempel, met aan beide zijden van de ingang twee zuilen in de dorische orde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church has a typical entrance in the form of the façade of a Greek temple, with two columns in the Doric order on either side of the entrance.

features.name: Islamic University of Applied Sciences Rotterdam

facts.text: Educator and author Hamdi Mert became the first chairman of the board.
facts.sourceQuote: The first chairman of the board was educator and author Hamdi Mert.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first chairman of the board was educator and author Hamdi Mert.

facts.text: The university officially commenced operations on November 21, 1997.
facts.sourceQuote: Under the leadership of founding rector Dr Damra, the institution took shape and officially commenced with the establishment of the university on 21 November 1997.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Under the leadership of founding rector Dr Damra, the institution took shape and officially commenced with the establishment of the university on 21 November 1997.

facts.text: Founding rector Dr Damra led the institution until his departure in August 2001.
facts.sourceQuote: Under the leadership of founding rector Dr Damra, the institution took shape and officially commenced with the establishment of the university on 21 November 1997. It lasted until Damra's departure in August 2001.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Under the leadership of founding rector Dr Damra, the institution took shape and officially commenced with the establishment of the university on 21 November 1997. It lasted until Damra's departure in August 2001.

facts.text: During its first years, the university formulated its mission and designed its academic programs.
facts.sourceQuote: During this time, the university's mission was formulated, the programme structure designed, the academic staff assembled, and the institutional identity developed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During this time, the university's mission was formulated, the programme structure designed, the academic staff assembled, and the institutional identity developed.

features.name: Andreaskerk

facts.text: The Andreaskerk honors Andreas Nesscher, the congregation's first pastor in 1604.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam van de kerk is ontleend aan Andreas Nesscher, de eerste predikant van deze gemeente in 1604.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name of the church is derived from Andreas Nesscher, the first pastor of this congregation in 1604.

facts.text: After WWII bombing destroyed its predecessor, this church opened in 1949 as a replacement.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kerkgebouw werd in 1949 in gebruik genomen, als vervanging van de Lutherse kerk in het centrum van Rotterdam, die als gevolg van het bombardement aan het begin van de Tweede Wereldoorlog verwoest werd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church building was put into use in 1949, as a replacement for the Lutheran church in the center of Rotterdam, which was destroyed as a result of the bombing at the beginning of World War II.

facts.text: Bastiaan van der Lecq designed this structure as Rotterdam's first reconstruction church.
facts.sourceQuote: De Andreaskerk is de eerste wederopbouwkerk van Rotterdam, gebouwd naar ontwerp van Bastiaan van der Lecq.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Andreaskerk is the first reconstruction church of Rotterdam, built according to the design of Bastiaan van der Lecq.

facts.text: The altar, banks, and pulpit are crafted from mahogany wood.
facts.sourceQuote: Banken, altaar en preekstoel zijn door de architect ontworpen en in mahoniehout uitgevoerd; het doopvont in steen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The banks, altar and pulpit were designed by the architect and made of mahogany wood; the baptismal font in stone.

facts.text: An annex connected by a corridor features halls, a refectory, and a courtyard.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bijgebouw, dat via een gang met de kerkzaal verbonden is, heeft mede door zijn zalen, kosterij en binnentuin een kloosterachtige uitstraling.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The annex, which is connected to the church hall via a corridor, has a monastic appearance partly due to its halls, refectory and courtyard.

features.opening: De Andreaskerk is de eerste wederopbouwkerk van Rotterdam, gebouwd naar ontwerp van Bastiaan van der Lecq.

features.name: Joods Kindermonument

facts.text: Wim Quist designed the semicircle monument listing every known child's name.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument is opgezet als een halve cirkel waarop de namen van alle kinderen zijn opgenoemd. Het is ontworpen door Wim Quist en op 10 april 2013 onthuld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument is set up as a semicircle on which the names of all the children are listed. It was designed by Wim Quist and unveiled on April 10, 2013.

features.opening: Het Joods Kindermonument in Rotterdam is een monument op de Kop van Zuid ter nagedachtenis aan de Rotterdamse Joodse kinderen die in de Tweede Wereldoorlog…

features.name: Centrale Bibliotheek

facts.text: Eero Aarnio's iconic 1968 Bubble Chair was displayed inside the library in 2006.
facts.sourceQuote: De Bubble Chair (1968) van Eero Aarnio was in 2006 te zien in de Centrale Bibliotheek Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Eero Aarnio's Bubble Chair (1968) was shown in the Centrale Bibliotheek Rotterdam in 2006.

facts.text: Exhibitions by artists Erwin Kho, Milan Hulsing, Erik de Graaf, and Albo Helm occurred in 2011.
facts.sourceQuote: Er waren verder bijvoorbeeld exposities van het Erwin Kho, Milan Hulsing, Erik de Graaf en Albo Helm (2011).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There were also exhibitions by, for example, Erwin Kho, Milan Hulsing, Erik de Graaf and Albo Helm (2011).

facts.text: Architects Jaap Bakema and Hans Boot won the design competition for Centrale Bibliotheek.
facts.sourceQuote: Het winnend ontwerp kwam van Jaap Bakema en Hans Boot van het architectenbureau Van den Broek & Bakema.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The winning design came from Jaap Bakema and Hans Boot of the architectural firm Van den Broek & Bakema.

facts.text: Queen Beatrix officially opened Centrale Bibliotheek on October 7, 1983.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 7 oktober 1983 werd het gebouw officieel geopend door Koningin Beatrix.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On October 7, 1983, the building was officially opened by Queen Beatrix.

facts.text: Erasmus's signature quote 'The whole world is my homeland' appears on the Binnenrotte facade.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de gevel aan de gedempte Binnenrotte staat een tekst van Erasmus, inclusief zijn handtekening: "Heel de wereld is mijn vaderland".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the facade on the quiet Binnenrotte stands a text by Erasmus, including his signature: "The whole world is my homeland".

features.opening: De Centrale Bibliotheek Rotterdam is de hoofdvestiging van Bibliotheek Rotterdam en bevindt zich aan de Binnenrotte in het centrum van de stad.

features.name: St. Mary's

facts.text: Russian occupiers once used the church as a prison, arsenal, and granary.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was in a poor state when the congregation returned in 1815 after the French and later the Russian occupiers had used the church as prison, arsenal and granary.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was in a poor state when the congregation returned in 1815 after the French and later the Russian occupiers had used the church as prison, arsenal and granary.

features.opening: St Mary's Church or the English Church (Dutch: Engelse Kerk) is an Anglican church in Rotterdam in the Netherlands.

features.name: Radio Museum

facts.text: The Rotterdams Radio Museum Foundation was established in 1988 by Harry de Jong sr.
facts.sourceQuote: De Stichting Rotterdams Radio Museum is in 1988 opgezet door Harry de Jong sr., een vroegere directeur van de firma Correct.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Rotterdams Radio Museum Foundation was founded in 1988 by Harry de Jong sr., a former director of the Correct company.

facts.text: Harry de Jong sr., a former director of the Correct company, founded this institution.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Rotterdams Radio Museum Foundation was founded in 1988 by Harry de Jong sr., a former director of the Correct company.

facts.text: A Jewish schoolboy named Hans Cats received a Philco radio in 1945 from an emigrant named John Pais.
facts.sourceQuote: Een van de radio's in het Radio Museum is de Philco 46-1201 ‘Bing Crosby’ Radio-Phono die de Joods-Rotterdamse scholier Hans Cats in 1945 kreeg van de Engelandvaarder John Pais.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: One of the radios in the Radio Museum is the Philco 46-1201 'Bing Crosby' Radio-Phono that the Jewish Rotterdam schoolboy Hans Cats received in 1945 from the emigrant John Pais.

features.opening: De Stichting Rotterdams Radio Museum is in 1988 opgezet door Harry de Jong sr., een vroegere directeur van de firma Correct.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Not far away is Lambertweg, named in 1927 after the Lambert family who had produced several mayors of Kralingen in the 18th and 19th centuries.

features.opening: De Sint-Lambertuskerk is een rooms-katholieke kerk in Rotterdam-Kralingen.

features.name: KINO

facts.text: Room 5 features a Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas theme while Room 6 mimics The Big Lebowski.
facts.sourceQuote: Zaal 5 werd gedecoreerd in het thema van de film Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas en zaal 6 in het thema van The Big Lebowski.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Room 5 was decorated in the theme of the film Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas and room 6 in the theme of The Big Lebowski.

facts.text: The venue houses a creative workplace called BURO for audiovisual entrepreneurs.
facts.sourceQuote: Naast de filmzalen bevat het een cocktailbar, een burgerrestaurant (NIKO's Resto) en een werkplek voor creatieve ondernemers in de audiovisuele industrie (BURO).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition to the movie theaters, it contains a cocktail bar, a burger restaurant (NIKO's Resto) and a workplace for creative entrepreneurs in the audiovisual industry (BURO).

facts.text: Six distinct screening rooms accommodate a total of 568 seats inside.
facts.sourceQuote: De bioscoop telt zes zalen met een totale capaciteit van 568 stoelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cinema has six rooms with a total capacity of 568 seats.

features.opening: KINO Rotterdam, kortweg Kino, is een bioscoop in Rotterdam, gevestigd in het pand van het voormalige LantarenVenster aan de Gouvernestraat.

facts.sourceQuote: The building contains a shop, exhibition space, study centre, and archive, as well as the Sonneveld House (a prime example of Nieuwe Zakelijkheid architecture), a pond, and a small park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building contains a shop, exhibition space, study centre, and archive, as well as the Sonneveld House (a prime example of Nieuwe Zakelijkheid architecture), a pond, and a small park.

facts.text: Jo Coenen designed the building that houses this cultural centre at Museumpark 25.
facts.sourceQuote: NI is in a building designed by Jo Coenen at Museumpark 25 in the centre of Rotterdam, adjacent to the Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: NI is in a building designed by Jo Coenen at Museumpark 25 in the centre of Rotterdam, adjacent to the Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen.

facts.text: Three separate institutes merged in 2013 to form the current Nieuwe Instituut.
facts.sourceQuote: Nieuwe Instituut (NI) formerly known as Het Nieuwe Instituut was formed in 2013, when then-secretary of state for Education, Culture, and Science Halbe Zijlstra ordered the merger of the Dutch institutes for architecture, design, and digital-culture.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Nieuwe Instituut (NI) formerly known as Het Nieuwe Instituut was formed in 2013, when then-secretary of state for Education, Culture, and Science Halbe Zijlstra ordered the merger of the Dutch institutes for architecture, design, and digital-culture.

facts.text: Architect Jo Coenen designed the Museum Park 25 structure that now holds the institute.
facts.sourceQuote: Thus the Netherlands Architecture Institute, Premsela Dutch Platform for Design and Fashion, and the Virtueel Platform were put together in the building at Museum Park 25, which was designed by Jo Coenen, and opened by Queen Beatrix in 1993.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Thus the Netherlands Architecture Institute, Premsela Dutch Platform for Design and Fashion, and the Virtueel Platform were put together in the building at Museum Park 25, which was designed by Jo Coenen, and opened by Queen Beatrix in 1993.

features.name: Hillegondakerk

facts.text: A castle and church were destroyed in 1426 during the Hoekse and Kabeljauwse disputes.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de donk stond ook een kasteel, Huis ten Berghe, dat in 1426 met de kerk werd verwoest door de Hoeken tijdens de Hoekse en Kabeljauwse twisten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the island there was also a castle, Huis ten Berghe, which was destroyed with the church in 1426 by the Hoeks during the Hoekse and Kabeljauwse disputes.

facts.text: The current church structure dates back to around the year 1500.
facts.sourceQuote: De Hillegondakerk in zijn huidige vorm stamt ongeveer uit het jaar 1500.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hillegondakerk in its current form dates back to around the year 1500.

facts.text: Remains of a castle tower were reused as building material for the church reconstruction.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kasteel waarvan bij de kerk een overblijfsel staat, is niet herbouwd; voor de herbouw van de kerk is gebruikgemaakt van de restanten van de kasteeltoren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The castle from which a remnant stands next to the church has not been rebuilt; the remains of the castle tower were used for the reconstruction of the church.

features.opening: De Hillegondakerk is een Nederlands-hervormde kerk in Rotterdam-Hillegersberg en is de oudste kerk van Rotterdam.

features.name: Depot Boijmans Van Beuningen

facts.text: Severe flooding in the old storage facility spurred the creation of this open public depot.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2013, there was severe flooding in the previous museum storage space. In the end, the losses were minimal but the risks associated with below sea-level storage were noted. Rather than create an out of town storage solution, the museum started considering the benefit of an open art depot.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2013, there was severe flooding in the previous museum storage space. In the end, the losses were minimal but the risks associated with below sea-level storage were noted. Rather than create an out of town storage solution, the museum started considering the benefit of an open art depot.

facts.text: Artworks requiring different conditions are stored in five distinct climate-controlled compartments.
facts.sourceQuote: More than 151,000 objects are housed together, arranged in fourteen storage compartments with five different climates. Each climate is for material that requires different kind of environmental conditions - a lower temperature, for example, is needed for colour photographs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: More than 151,000 objects are housed together, arranged in fourteen storage compartments with five different climates. Each climate is for material that requires different kind of environmental conditions - a lower temperature, for example, is needed for colour photographs.

facts.text: King Willem-Alexander officially opened the depot on November 5, 2021.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 12, 2022, the Depot received the Best Building award in the 'Stimulating Environments' category by the Dutch Architectural Firms Association (BNA).

features.name: Wilhelminafontein

facts.text: Architect Henri Evers designed the column while sculptor Simon Miedema created its images.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is een ontwerp van prof. dr Henri Evers, de architect van het Rotterdamse stadhuis. De beelden op het monument zijn van de hand van Simon Miedema, die ook de beelden ontwierp voor het Witte Huis in Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is a design by Prof. Dr. Henri Evers, the architect of the Rotterdam town hall. The images on the monument are by the hand of Simon Miedema, who also designed the images for the White House in Rotterdam.

facts.text: Roots from a chestnut tree planted in 1898 cracked the monument enough to force its removal in the 1990s.
facts.sourceQuote: De fontein werd aan het begin van de jaren negentig verwijderd, nadat de wortels van de - waarschijnlijk eveneens in 1898 geplante - kastanjeboom scheuren in het monument hadden veroorzaakt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The fountain was removed at the beginning of the 1990s, after the roots of the - probably also planted in 1898 - chestnut tree had caused cracks in the monument.

features.opening: De Wilhelminafontein in Rotterdam is een monumentale fontein op het Noordereiland op het Burgemeester Hoffmanplein.

features.name: Coolsingel Gate

facts.text: Ambulances entered and exited through this gate when it served the Coolsingel hospital.
facts.sourceQuote: Door de poort aan de toenmalige Crispijnlaan reden de ambulances in en uit.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Through the gate on the then Crispijnlaan, the ambulances came in and out.

facts.text: The gate survived the May 1940 bombing that destroyed the rest of the hospital.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ziekenhuis werd tijdens het bombardement op Rotterdam in mei 1940 verwoest waarbij enkele buitenmuren en de poort overeind bleven staan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The hospital was destroyed during the bombing of Rotterdam in May 1940, leaving some outer walls and the gate standing.

facts.text: Locals call the area where the gate stands Lijnbaanplein.
facts.sourceQuote: De poort en een inmiddels enorme plataan staan op het door de volksmond Lijnbaanplein genoemde stukje van de Lijnbaan; ze zijn de enige nog bestaande overblijfselen van het ziekenhuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The gate and an enormous plane tree that has grown since then are located on the section of the Lijnbaan known as Lijnbaanplein by the locals; they are the only remaining remnants of the hospital.

facts.text: Local politicians successfully blocked a 2006 plan to move the gate to a new medical center.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2006 waren er plannen om de poort te schenken aan het Erasmus Medisch Centrum opdat zij een plaats zou krijgen bij de nieuwbouw. Het Historisch Genootschap Roterodamum wist de lokale politiek te bewegen om dit plan tegen te houden, opdat de herinnering aan het Coolsingelziekenhuis bleef.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2006, plans were made to donate the gate to the Erasmus Medical Center so that it would have a place in the new building. The Historical Society Roterodamum managed to move local politics to prevent this plan, so that the memory of the Coolsingel hospital would remain.

features.opening: De Coolsingelpoort aan de Lijnbaan in de Nederlandse stad Rotterdam was de achterpoort van het voormalige Coolsingelziekenhuis aan de Coolsingel.

facts.sourceQuote: Het monument getuigt van de dankbaarheid van de wijkbewoners voor de bevrijding aan het einde van de Tweede Wereldoorlog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument testifies to the gratitude of the neighborhood residents for the liberation at the end of World War II.

facts.text: Artists Joan Bakker and J.Poot created the column featuring dancing figures and an attached lion.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument van Joan Bakker en J.Poot werd op 5 mei 1950 door burgemeester Oud onthuld en bestaat uit een zuil waarop onderaan dansende figuren zijn uitgebeeld en waarbovenop een leeuw is aangebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument of Joan Bakker and J.Poot was unveiled on May 5, 1950 by Mayor Oud and consists of a column on which dancing figures are depicted at the bottom and a lion is attached above it.

facts.text: The pillar bears the inscription: 5 MAY 1945 WE REMEMBER OUR CASUALTIES.

facts.text: Activists vandalized the center with red handprints during June 2020 protests against colonial symbols.
facts.sourceQuote: In June 2020, as part of the George Floyd protests in the Netherlands, activists vandalized symbols of colonialism in Rotterdam. These included the Piet Hein statue in Delfshaven, the Pim Fortuyn memorial and the Witte de With Center, where they left handprints in red paint.

These included the Piet Hein statue in Delfshaven, the Pim Fortuyn memorial and the Witte de With Center, where they left handprints in red paint.

facts.text: Critics previously argued the center had failed to reconcile its internal contradictions regarding its namesake.

In response, the center titled its next exhibition Witte de With; What's in a name?.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: An open letter from Martina and others stated, "Witte de With has 'failed' to come to terms with its own internal contradictions, and has yet to reckon with the historical figure it symbolically embodies." In response, the center titled its next exhibition Witte de With; What's in a name?.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The art house was formerly known as the Witte de With Center for Contemporary Art and was established in 1990 as a center for contemporary art with a mission of curating and exhibiting international art exhibitions.
