facts.sourceQuote: Defne Ayas was appointed director in 2012, and was succeeded by Sofía Hernández Chong Cuy in 2018, and Gabi Ngcobo in 2024.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Defne Ayas was appointed director in 2012, and was succeeded by Sofía Hernández Chong Cuy in 2018, and Gabi Ngcobo in 2024.

features.opening: Kunstinstituut Melly is a contemporary art house located in a former school building on Witte de Withstraat, in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

features.name: Willem de Kooning Academy

facts.text: In 1998 the school adopted its current name, Willem de Kooning Academy, following earlier titles.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1970 the school was renamed Academie van Beeldende Kunsten, and finally Willem de Kooning Academie in 1998.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1970 the school was renamed Academie van Beeldende Kunsten, and finally Willem de Kooning Academie in 1998.

facts.text: Jan Hendrik van de Laar headed the merged academy located at the Coolvest starting in 1851.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1851 the Academie van Beeldende Kunsten en Technische Wetenschappen was founded from the merger of the Rotterdamse Tekengenootschap and the Rotterdamse Industrieschool. It was located in a building at the Coolvest, now Coolsingel, and headed by Jan Hendrik van de Laar (1807–1874).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1851 the Academie van Beeldende Kunsten en Technische Wetenschappen was founded from the merger of the Rotterdamse Tekengenootschap and the Rotterdamse Industrieschool. It was located in a building at the Coolvest, now Coolsingel, and headed by Jan Hendrik van de Laar (1807–1874).

features.opening: The Willem de Kooning Academy (Dutch: Willem de Kooning Academie) is a Dutch academy of media, art, design, leisure and education based in Rotterdam.

features.name: Atlantikwall-Museum

facts.text: One original bunker is classified as a German 625b type artillery structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum werd gevestigd in een Duitse geschutsbunker van het type 625b, die deel uitmaakte van de verdediging van Marine-Flak-Batterie Nordmole.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was housed in a German 625b type artillery bunker, which was part of the defense of Marine-Flak-Batterie Nordmole.

facts.text: Volunteers manage the Atlantikwall-Museum and its collections today.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum wordt door vrijwilligers beheerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum is managed by volunteers.

features.opening: Het Atlantikwall-museum is een bezoekers- en kenniscentrum in het Zuid-Hollandse Hoek van Holland met betrekking tot de Atlantikwall.

features.name: Pathé de Kuip

facts.text: Pathé de Kuip opened its doors to the public in the year 2002.
facts.sourceQuote: Pathé de Kuip werd in 2002 geopend en is een megabioscoop geëxploiteerd door Pathé Nederland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Pathé de Kuip was opened in 2002 and is a megaplex cinema operated by Pathé Netherlands.

facts.text: The venue features fourteen screening rooms distributed across three separate floors.
facts.sourceQuote: De bioscoop telt 14 zalen verdeeld over 3 verdiepingen met in totaal 2746 stoelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cinema has 14 rooms spread over 3 floors with a total of 2746 seats.

facts.text: Pathé de Kuip takes its name from the adjacent De Kuip stadium where Feyenoord plays.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam van deze bioscoop is afgeleid van het naast gelegen voetbalstadion De Kuip waarin Feyenoord zijn voetbalwedstrijden speelt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name of this cinema is derived from the adjacent football stadium De Kuip where Feyenoord plays its football matches.

facts.text: Every room is accessible with disabled seating located at the top of each theater.
facts.sourceQuote: Voor rolstoelen geldt het als een toegankelijk theater. Dit doordat iedere zaal toegankelijk is voor een mindervalide en doordat de mindervalide plekken zich bovenaan de zaal bevinden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For wheelchairs, it is considered an accessible theater. This is because every room is accessible to a person with a disability and because the disabled places are located at the top of the room.

facts.text: A Pathé Boulevard offering expanded food choices opened in early 2018.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds begin 2018 is Pathé De Kuip uitgerust met een zogenoemde Pathé Boulevard, waarbij bezoekers keuze hebben uit een groter assortiment eten en drinken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since the beginning of 2018, Pathé De Kuip has been equipped with a so-called Pathé Boulevard, where visitors have the choice from a larger selection of food and drinks.

features.opening: Pathé de Kuip werd in 2002 geopend en is een megabioscoop geëxploiteerd door Pathé Nederland.

features.name: KunstHAL

facts.text: Dutch architect Rem Koolhaas designed the structure alongside project architect Fuminori Hoshino from OMA.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was designed by the Dutch architect Rem Koolhaas together with project architect Fuminori Hoshino of the architectural firm OMA (Office for Metropolitan Architecture).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was designed by the Dutch architect Rem Koolhaas together with project architect Fuminori Hoshino of the architectural firm OMA (Office for Metropolitan Architecture).

facts.text: The alleged thieves reportedly met on the dating app Tinder before committing the crime.
facts.sourceQuote: The alleged thieves were arrested in Romania in July 2013. They reportedly met on Tinder.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The alleged thieves were arrested in Romania in July 2013. They reportedly met on Tinder.

facts.text: Investigators found age-appropriate pigments and nails in a suspect's fireplace after the theft.
facts.sourceQuote: However, investigators found pigments and nails of the correct age for the stolen paintings in her fireplace.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, investigators found pigments and nails of the correct age for the stolen paintings in her fireplace.

features.opening: The Kunsthal (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈkʏnstɦɑl] ; English: Art Hall) is an art space in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.

features.name: Sint-Liduina

facts.text: Sint-Liduina honors Liduina van Schiedam, the saint after whom the church is named.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk is vernoemd naar Liduina van Schiedam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church is named after Liduina van Schiedam.

facts.text: The final Holy Mass occurred on April 12, 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 1 januari 2014 maakt de kerk deel uit van de Bernadetteparochie en sinds 2015 staat het op de nominatie gesloten te gaan worden en te fuseren samen met kerken in Overschie tot een nieuw te bouwen kerk in Schiebroek die de Bernadettekerk is gaan heten. op 12 april 2026 met Beloken Pasen vond in de Liduinakerk de allerlaatste Heilige Mis plaats en werd aan de eredienst onttrokken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since January 1, 2014, the church has been part of the Bernadette parish and since 2015 it has been nominated to be closed and merged together with churches in Overschie into a new church to be built in Schiebroek that has come to be called the Bernadette church. On April 12, 2026 with Beloken Easter, the very last Holy Mass took place in the Liduinakerk and was deprived of the service.

features.opening: De Sint-Liduinakerk is een katholieke kerk aan de Burgemeester Le Fèvre de Montignylaan in Hillegersberg (gemeente Rotterdam).

features.name: Essalam

facts.text: Construction faced repeated standstills before the mosque finally opened in 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: De bouw van een nieuw gebedshuis duurde van 2003 tot 2010 en is met veel problemen gepaard gegaan waarbij de bouw regelmatig stil viel. De Essalammoskee is ten slotte op 2010 in gebruik genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The construction of a new mosque lasted from 2003 to 2010 and was accompanied by many problems, with construction regularly coming to a standstill. Finally, the Essalammoskee was put into use in 2010.

facts.text: The facade features colored natural stone plates accented with nuanced blue-gray stone.
facts.sourceQuote: De gevel is bekleed met gekleurde natuurstenen platen en heeft accenten in genuanceerde blauwgrijze steen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The facade is covered with colored natural stone plates and has accents in nuanced blue-gray stone.

features.opening: De Essalammoskee is een grote moskee in de Rotterdamse wijk Feijenoord, nabij voetbalstadion de Kuip.

features.name: Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam

facts.text: Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam is the first Dutch university named after a person.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1973, the Medical Faculty Rotterdam and the Netherlands School of Economics merged, after which the institution was renamed under its current name Erasmus University Rotterdam (Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam) – the first university in the Netherlands named after a person, a man to whom Rotterdam owes the reputation it has held for centuries in the academic world.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1973, the Medical Faculty Rotterdam and the Netherlands School of Economics merged, after which the institution was renamed under its current name Erasmus University Rotterdam (Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam) – the first university in the Netherlands named after a person, a man to whom Rotterdam owes the reputation it has held for centuries in the academic world.

facts.text: The institution began as the Netherlands School of Commerce in 1913 before gaining university status in 1937.
facts.sourceQuote: Erasmus University Rotterdam was founded on 8 November 1913 as the Netherlands School of Commerce (Nederlandsche Handels-Hoogeschool, or NHH) through private initiative with broad support from the business community of Rotterdam. In 1937, the school was recognized as a higher educational institute with university status, providing education in commerce and economics as an academic discipline.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Erasmus University Rotterdam was founded on 8 November 1913 as the Netherlands School of Commerce (Nederlandsche Handels-Hoogeschool, or NHH) through private initiative with broad support from the business community of Rotterdam. In 1937, the school was recognized as a higher educational institute with university status, providing education in commerce and economics as an academic discipline.

features.name: Darwin's rhea

facts.text: John Gould described Darwin's rhea as Rhea darwinii in 1837 during a presentation to the Zoological Society of London.
facts.section: History of the discovery of the genus Rhea
facts.sourceQuote: In 1837, Darwin's rhea was described as Rhea darwinii (later synonymized with R. pennata) by the ornithologist John Gould in a presentation to the Zoological Society of London, in which he was followed by Darwin reading a paper on the eggs and distribution of the two species of rheas.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1837, Darwin's rhea was described as Rhea darwinii (later synonymized with R. pennata) by the ornithologist John Gould in a presentation to the Zoological Society of London, in which he was followed by Darwin reading a paper on the eggs and distribution of the two species of rheas.

features.opening: Darwin's rhea or the lesser rhea (Rhea pennata) is a large flightless bird, the smaller of the two extant species of rheas.

features.name: Geloof en Vrijheid

facts.text: On October 18, 1942, German forces attacked underground workers at this location.
facts.sourceQuote: Geloof en Vrijheid is een gedenkteken aan het gebouw in de 1e Pijnackerstraat in Rotterdam, waar op 18 oktober 1942 een groep ondergrondse werkers door de Duitsers werd overvallen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Geloof en Vrijheid is a monument to the building in the 1st Pijnackerstraat in Rotterdam, where on October 18, 1942, a group of underground workers was attacked by the Germans.

facts.text: The relief artwork was created by the artist Loekie Metz.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kunstwerk werd gemaakt door Loekie Metz.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The artwork was created by Loekie Metz.

facts.text: A torch figure with outstretched arms shelters men, women, and children below.
facts.sourceQuote: Het reliëf bestaat uit een fakkel, waarin bovenaan een figuur het verzet uitbeeldt. Onder zijn gespreide armen zoeken mannen, vrouwen en kinderen bescherming.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The relief consists of a torch, in which at the top a figure depicts the resistance. Under his outstretched arms, men, women and children seek protection.

features.name: Volharding 1

facts.text: Volharding 1 escorted the SS Rotterdam from Hoek van Holland to Rotterdam on August 4, 2008.
facts.sourceQuote: Op maandag 4 augustus 2008 escorteerde de Volharding 1 het SS Rotterdam van Hoek van Holland naar Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On Monday, August 4, 2008, the Volharding 1 escorted the SS Rotterdam from Hoek van Holland to Rotterdam.

facts.text: In May 1940, the tug evacuated people and livestock from Vreeswijk to Wageningen.
facts.sourceQuote: In mei 1940 werden de bommen van de Luftwaffe ontweken op het Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal en op de sluis in Vreeswijk werd de stoomsleepboot naar Wageningen gestuurd voor evacuatie van mensen en dieren (koeien en paarden).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In May 1940, the bombs of the Luftwaffe were avoided on the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal and at the lock in Vreeswijk the steam tugboat was sent to Wageningen for the evacuation of people and animals (cows and horses).

facts.text: A US military Delco-Remy generator was installed to produce electricity without steam.
facts.sourceQuote: Onder andere werd een schroefas-generator ingebouwd, een Delco-Remy afkomstig van het US leger depôt, die geen extra stoom vroeg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Among other things, a screw shaft generator was installed, a Delco-Remy from the US military depot, which did not require extra steam.

features.opening: De Volharding 1 is een door stoom aangedreven Nederlandse sleepboot.

features.name: Witte Huis

facts.text: Only one of two Rotterdam maps features the building before the city was blitzed.
facts.sourceQuote: The White House is only featured in one of the two maps called "Rotterdam", which is the one before the Rotterdam Blitz happened.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The White House is only featured in one of the two maps called "Rotterdam", which is the one before the Rotterdam Blitz happened.

facts.text: 1000 piles were driven into the soft soil to support the structure's weight.
facts.sourceQuote: The site at Wijnhaven 3 is just 1 m above sea-level and skeptics claimed that the soft soil of Rotterdam would be unable to adequately support the building, so before construction could properly begin, 1000 piles were driven into the ground to support the building's weight.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The site at Wijnhaven 3 is just 1 m above sea-level and skeptics claimed that the soft soil of Rotterdam would be unable to adequately support the building, so before construction could properly begin, 1000 piles were driven into the ground to support the building's weight.

facts.text: Architect Willem Molenbroek designed the ten-storey tower at an unprecedented European height.
facts.sourceQuote: The architect Willem Molenbroek designed the 10-storey building, at the time an unprecedented height in Europe.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architect Willem Molenbroek designed the 10-storey building, at the time an unprecedented height in Europe.

features.name: O.L.V. Altijddurende Bijstand

facts.text: Architects Hendriks, Van der Sluys & Van den Bosch designed this typical Delft School reconstruction church.
facts.sourceQuote: Het architectenbureau Hendriks, Van der Sluys & Van den Bosch werd aangetrokken voor het ontwerp. Het resultaat was een typische wederopbouwkerk in de stijl van de Delftse School.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architectural firm Hendriks, Van der Sluys & Van den Bosch was hired for the design. The result was a typical reconstruction church in the style of the Delft School.

facts.text: After closing in 2019, the building was converted into an apartment complex.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd in 2019 gesloten en is verbouwd tot appartementencomplex.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was closed in 2019 and has been converted into an apartment complex.

features.opening: De Onze-Lieve-Vrouw van Altijddurende Bijstandkerk is een voormalige katholieke kerk in de deelgemeente Overschie in Rotterdam.

features.name: Stieltjesmonument

facts.text: Stieltjesmonument honors Thomas Joannes Stieltjes sr., the engineer who designed the Feijenoord harbors.
facts.sourceQuote: Thomas Joannes Stieltjes sr. (Leuven 1819 - Rotterdam 1878) was militair en waterstaatkundig ingenieur. Hij wordt gezien als de architect van de aanleg van de havens in de wijk Feijenoord ten zuiden van de Nieuwe Maas.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Thomas Joannes Stieltjes sr. (Leuven 1819 - Rotterdam 1878) was a military and hydraulic engineer. He is seen as the architect of the construction of the harbors in the Feijenoord district south of the Nieuwe Maas.

facts.text: Sculptor Eugène Lacomblé created a white marble relief portrait for the monument's design.
facts.sourceQuote: De beeldhouwer Eugène Lacomblé maakte een reliëfportret in wit marmer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The sculptor Eugène Lacomblé made a relief portrait in white marble.

facts.text: Guests traveled by tram to the ceremony where speeches were delivered on May 17, 1884.
facts.sourceQuote: De overdracht van het gedenkteken en het medaillon vond plaats op 17 mei 1884, tijdens een plechtigheid op het stadhuis van Rotterdam. Na een lunch gingen de genodigden per tram naar het monument, waar een aantal redes werd gehouden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The transfer of the monument and the medallion took place on May 17, 1884, during a ceremony at the town hall of Rotterdam. After lunch, the guests went by tram to the monument, where a number of speeches were given.

facts.text: A pinecone crowns the column's capital, which features a winged helmet head on all four sides.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kapiteel van de zuil, waarin aan vier zijden een kop met een gevleugelde helm is te zien, wordt bekroond door een pijnappel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The capital of the column, in which a head with a winged helmet can be seen on four sides, is crowned by a pinecone.

facts.text: The west side displays a relief of a passer, triangle, and helmet symbolizing his engineering work.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de oostzijde is het en profilportret van Stieltjes aangebracht, aan de westzijde een reliëf van een lauwerkrans en attributen die verwijzen naar Stieltjes als ingenieur en krijgskundige (passer, driehoek en helm).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the east side is a profile portrait of Stieltjes, on the west side a relief of a laurel wreath and attributes that refer to Stieltjes as an engineer and military strategist (passer, triangle and helmet).

features.opening: Het Stieltjesmonument is een gedenkteken op het Noordereiland in de Nederlandse gemeente Rotterdam ter nagedachtenis aan Th.J.

features.name: de Doelen

facts.text: The venue was destroyed in May 1940 during the German bombardment of Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: It was originally built in 1934 but then destroyed in 1940 during the German bombardment of Rotterdam in May 1940 at the outset of World War II.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was originally built in 1934 but then destroyed in 1940 during the German bombardment of Rotterdam in May 1940 at the outset of World War II.

facts.text: De Doelen serves as the central box office for the International Film Festival Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: Although mainly known as a venue for classical music, de Doelen is also a stage for jazz and world music, and is the central box office for the International Film Festival Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although mainly known as a venue for classical music, de Doelen is also a stage for jazz and world music, and is the central box office for the International Film Festival Rotterdam.

features.opening: De Doelen is a concert venue and convention centre in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Het Steiger

facts.text: The first Dominican church between Hoogstraat and Het Steiger was built in 1790.
facts.sourceQuote: In de Franse tijd kregen katholieken dezelfde rechten als protestanten, waaronder het recht op een eigen kerkgebouw naar het aantal gelovigen. In 1790 konden de dominicanen hun eerste kerkje bouwen tussen de Hoogstraat en het Steiger.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the French period, Catholics received the same rights as Protestants, including the right to their own church building according to the number of believers. In 1790, the Dominicans were able to build their first church between the Hoogstraat and the Steiger.

facts.text: Mosaics at the entrance were created by Theo Mols while reliefs were made by Pim van Moorsel.
facts.sourceQuote: De mozaïeken aan weerszijden van de entree zijn van de hand van Theo Mols, de reliëfs aan de toren en in de daklijst werden gemaakt door Pim van Moorsel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The mosaics on either side of the entrance are by Theo Mols, the reliefs on the tower and in the cornice were made by Pim van Moorsel.

features.opening: Het Steiger is een voormalige rooms-katholieke parochiekerk en aangrenzend dominicanerklooster in de binnenstad van Rotterdam.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The privilege to found a Latin school was granted to the town of Rotterdam before Rotterdam received full city rights and therefore the school predates the city status of Rotterdam by nearly twenty years.

facts.text: Memorials were first placed at multiple addresses including Berglustlaan in 2011.
facts.sourceQuote: 2011: Berglustlaan 7 en 64 en 214a, Burgemeester Le Fèvre de Montignylaan 26, Jan van Ghestellaan 28, Juliana van Stolberglaan 71 2012: Nieuwe Kerkstraat 22b 2014: Jan van Ghestellaan 29, Straatweg 68a 4 mei 2017: Merellaan 21 8 maart 2019: C.N.A.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: 2011: Berglustlaan 7 and 64 and 214a, Burgemeester Le Fèvre de Montignylaan 26, Jan van Ghestellaan 28, Juliana van Stolberglaan 71 2012: Nieuwe Kerkstraat 22b 2014: Jan van Ghestellaan 29, Straatweg 68a May 4, 2017: Merellaan 21 March 8, 2019: C.N.A.

features.opening: De Lijst van Stolpersteine in Hillegersberg-Schiebroek geeft een overzicht van de gedenkstenen die in stadskwartier Hillegersberg-Schiebroek in de Nederlandse…

features.name: Kubuswoningen

facts.text: The design by Piet Blom is a larger variant of the Helmond cube house grid.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ontwerp van Piet Blom is een variant op de Helmondse kubuswoning in een iets groter maatraster.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design by Piet Blom is a variant of the Helmond cube house in a slightly larger grid size.

facts.text: The entire complex is locally known as Blaakse Bos rather than just the viaduct name Overblaak.
facts.sourceQuote: Het viaduct op één hoog heet officieel de Overblaak, maar het hele complex staat bekend als het Blaakse Bos.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The viaduct on one level is officially called the Overblaak, but the entire complex is known as the Blaakse Bos.

facts.text: Construction occurred between 1982 and 1984 following plans presented in 1978.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze zijn gebouwd tussen 1982 en 1984, na een eerste presentatie van de plannen in 1978.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: They were built between 1982 and 1984, after a first presentation of the plans in 1978.

facts.text: The cubes rest on hexagonal columns containing the entrance and staircase.
facts.sourceQuote: In de zeshoekige kolom waarop de woning rust, bevinden zich de entree en het trappenhuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the hexagonal column on which the house rests, there are the entrance and the staircase.

features.opening: De kubuswoningen in Rotterdam zijn 38 kubusvormige paalwoningen en 13 bedrijfskubussen bij de Blaak nabij de Oude Haven.

features.name: Havenspoorlijn Rotterdam West

facts.text: Daily scrap trains used wagons with yellow corner stripes, earning the nickname 'yellowbanders'.
facts.sourceQuote: De hiervoor gebruikte wagons hadden als kenmerk gele strepen op de hoeken, daarom werden ze in spoorjargon 'geelbanders' genoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The wagons used for this had characteristic yellow stripes on the corners, which is why they were called 'yellowbanders' in railway jargon.

facts.text: A direct orange train from Spain ran to Rotterdam companies for many years.
facts.sourceQuote: Jarenlang heeft er een rechtstreekse trein gereden tussen Spanje en Rotterdam (41815), waarmee wagonladingen sinaasappelen werden aangevoerd naar bedrijven als Velleman en Tas, Henk van den Berg en Zoutewelle.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For years, there was a direct train running between Spain and Rotterdam (41815), with wagonloads of oranges being transported to companies such as Velleman and Tas, Henk van den Berg and Zoutewelle.

facts.text: Tracks east of Schiemond vanished between 2000 and 2002, erasing the Hudsonstraat station site.
facts.sourceQuote: De sporen ten oosten van Schiemond zijn tussen 2000 en 2002 opgebroken en het emplacement aan de Hudsonstraat is geheel verdwenen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tracks east of Schiemond were dismantled between 2000 and 2002 and the Hudsonstraat station site has completely disappeared.

facts.text: A one-kilometer rooftop park now covers Bigshops Parkboulevard, a shopping promenade opened in 2011.
facts.sourceQuote: In het vrijgekomen deel werd een dakpark aangelegd. Dit dakpark is 1 kilometer lang en eronder ligt Bigshops Parkboulevard (geopend in 2011), een winkelpromenade waar grote winkels zijn gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A rooftop park was built in the available part. This rooftop park is 1 kilometer long and underneath it lies Bigshops Parkboulevard (opened in 2011), a shopping promenade where large stores are located.

facts.text: Old signals and signage remain on display along the unpaved walking path where the railway embankment once stood.
facts.sourceQuote: Heden is de spoordijk vanaf het Marconiplein ten westen van Spangen een onverhard wandelpad. Een aantal spoorattributen zoals seinen en bebording zijn nog te bezichtigen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Today, the railway embankment from Marconiplein west of Spangen is an unpaved walking path. A number of railway attributes such as signals and signage are still on display.

features.opening: De Havenspoorlijn Rotterdam West was een goederenspoorlijn met vier emplacementen in Rotterdam-West op de rechter Maasoever.

features.name: Steen van de miljoenen tranen

facts.text: The monument commemorates fires that raged for days after a fifteen-minute bombing.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bombardement op Rotterdam op 14 mei 1940 duurde een kwartier, maar de brand heeft dagen gewoed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bombing of Rotterdam on May 14, 1940 lasted a quarter of an hour, but the fire raged for days.

features.opening: De Steen van de miljoenen tranen is een herdenkingsmonument aan de Willem Ruyslaan te Rotterdam.

features.name: Hervormde kerk

facts.text: The current structure replaced a thirteenth-century building in 1926.
facts.sourceQuote: Het huidige kerkgebouw is uit 1926 en is in de plaats gekomen van een gebouw uit oorspronkelijk de dertiende eeuw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current church building dates from 1926 and replaced a building originally from the thirteenth century.

facts.text: The tower features brick construction with natural stone corner blocks and arched friezes.
facts.sourceQuote: De toren is een bakstenen bouwwerk met natuurstenen hoekblokken en spaarvelden met boogfriezen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tower is a brick structure with natural stone corner blocks and terraced fields with arched friezes.

features.opening: De Nederlands Hervormde Kerk is een kerk in Pernis.

features.name: Havenmuseum

facts.text: Havenmuseum formed in 2002 by merging the Open Air Inland Waterway Museum Foundation and the Maritime Outdoor Museum.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum is in 2002 ontstaan door samenvoeging van de Stichting Openlucht Binnenvaartmuseum (SOB) en het Maritiem Buitenmuseum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was created in 2002 by the merger of the Open Air Inland Waterway Museum Foundation (SOB) and the Maritime Outdoor Museum.

facts.text: Both institutions now operate under the single umbrella of the Maritime Museum Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: Beide musea gaan samen onder de noemer Maritiem Museum Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Both museums are now operating under the umbrella of the Maritime Museum Rotterdam.

features.opening: Het Havenmuseum bevindt zich in en aan de Leuvehaven in de Zuid-Hollandse stad Rotterdam.

features.name: Hoornbeeck College

facts.text: The school honors Reformed professor Johannes Hoornbeeck.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam van de school is ontleend aan de reformatorische hoogleraar Johannes Hoornbeeck.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name of the school is derived from the Reformed professor Johannes Hoornbeeck.

facts.text: Students can choose from over ninety courses across four major sectors.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Hoornbeeck College biedt meer dan 90 opleidingen aan in de sectoren Economie & Handel, Gezondheidszorg & Welzijn, Technologie en Dienstverlening.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Hoornbeeck College offers more than 90 courses in the sectors Economy & Trade, Healthcare & Welfare, Technology and Services.

facts.text: Branch offices exist in cities like Gouda, Kampen, and Rotterdam alongside Amersfoort.
facts.sourceQuote: De hoofdvestiging staat in Amersfoort en er zijn nevenvestigingen in Apeldoorn, Goes, Gouda, Kampen en Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The main branch is located in Amersfoort and there are branch offices in Apeldoorn, Goes, Gouda, Kampen and Rotterdam.

facts.text: Students must attend a Reformed church and believe in the Trinity of God to enroll.
facts.sourceQuote: Zo moet een leerling naar een reformatorische kerk gaan en geloven in de Drie-eenheid van God.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For example, a student must go to a Reformed church and believe in the Trinity of God.

facts.text: The Bible serves as the daily basis and guideline for all school practices.
facts.sourceQuote: Voor de dagelijkse praktijk in de school geldt de Bijbel als grondslag en richtsnoer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For daily practice in the school, the Bible is the basis and guideline.

features.opening: Het Hoornbeeck College is een reformatorische school die onderwijs aanbiedt op mbo-niveau.

features.name: Treurende vrouw

facts.text: Treurende vrouw means 'weeping woman', matching the seated figure holding her head.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld op een sokkel toont uit een zittende treurende vrouw, haar hoofd ondersteunend met een hand.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image on a pedestal depicts a seated weeping woman, holding her head with one hand.

facts.text: A mother of one executed fighter revealed the monument on May 3, 1958.
facts.sourceQuote: Het werd op 3 mei 1958 door een moeder van een van de gefusilleerden onthuld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was revealed on May 3, 1958 by a mother of one of the executed.

facts.text: A second monument called Il Grande Miracolo stands nearby on Pleinweg.
facts.sourceQuote: Even verderop, aan de Pleinweg, is een tweede monument geplaatst ter herinnering aan de twintig gefusilleerden: Il Grande Miracolo ofwel 'De Vallende ruiter' van Marino Marini.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Just further along, on the Pleinweg, a second monument has been placed in memory of the twenty executed: Il Grande Miracolo or 'The Falling Rider' by Marino Marini.

features.opening: Treurende vrouw is een oorlogsmonument in Rotterdam.

features.name: Paradijskerk

facts.text: Pointed side towers with sloping upper lines were very unusual in the Netherlands at that time.
facts.sourceQuote: De spitse zijtorens met hun aflopende bovenlijsten zijn voor die tijd in Nederland zeer ongebruikelijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The pointed side towers with their sloping upper lines are very unusual in the Netherlands at that time.

facts.text: Organ builder Christian Gottlieb Friedrich Witte reused parts of Matthijs Verhofstadt's 1721 pipework.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de bouw van dit orgel in 1858 maakt Christian Gottlieb Friedrich Witte gebruik van de bestaande oude orgelkas en handhaaft hij ook een deel van het bestaande pijpwerk van de Gemertse orgelbouwer Matthijs Verhofstadt. De kas van het orgel dateert uit 1721, toen Verhofstadt een nieuw orgel voor de vorige Paradijskerk leverde en is ontworpen door de Vlaamse beeldhouwer Alexander Dominicus Pluskens.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When building this organ in 1858, Christian Gottlieb Friedrich Witte used the existing old organ case and also maintained part of the existing pipework of the Gemert organ builder Matthijs Verhofstadt. The organ case dates back to 1721, when Verhofstadt delivered a new organ for the previous Paradijskerk and was designed by the Flemish sculptor Alexander Dominicus Pluskens.

facts.text: A 1972 restoration used the 1858 condition as its starting point for repairs.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1972/73 voert de firma Verschueren (Heythuysen) een algehele restauratie uit, waarbij de toestand van 1858 als uitgangspunt geldt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1972/73, the Verschueren (Heythuysen) company carried out a general restoration, using the condition of 1858 as the starting point.

facts.text: New Quint and Octave stops replaced older Viola d'Amour and Wood Flute registers in the main work.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het hoofdwerk worden de registers Viola d’Amour 8' en Woudfluit 2' vervangen door een nieuwe Quint 3' en een nieuwe Octaaf 2' en wordt de samenstelling van de Cornet gewijzigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the main work, the registers Viola d'Amour 8' and Wood Flute 2' are replaced by a new Quint 3' and a new Octave 2' and the composition of the Cornet is changed.

features.opening: De Paradijskerk is een oudkatholiek kerkgebouw aan de Nieuwe Binnenweg in Rotterdam.

features.name: Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen

facts.text: A fire in 1864 destroyed much of the museum's original collection before it could be rebuilt.
facts.sourceQuote: Much of the museum's original collection was destroyed in a fire in 1864.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Much of the museum's original collection was destroyed in a fire in 1864.

facts.text: Painter Arie Johannes Lamme served as the institution's very first director after its founding.
facts.sourceQuote: The painter and art dealer, Arie Johannes Lamme, was named the museum's first director.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The painter and art dealer, Arie Johannes Lamme, was named the museum's first director.

facts.text: Ronny Naftaniel unsuccessfully demanded removing Van Beuningen's name due to alleged Nazi-era thefts.
facts.sourceQuote: A representative of the Dutch Jewish community, Ronny Naftaniel, demanded - without success - the removal of Van Beuningen's name. It was alleged that acquisitions in Van Beuningen's collection has been illegally taken from Jewish owners during the period of Nazi occupation in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A representative of the Dutch Jewish community, Ronny Naftaniel, demanded - without success - the removal of Van Beuningen's name. It was alleged that acquisitions in Van Beuningen's collection has been illegally taken from Jewish owners during the period of Nazi occupation in the Netherlands.

features.opening: Municipal Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen (Dutch pronunciation: [myˈzeːjʏm ˈboːimɑns fɑm ˈbøːnɪŋə(n)]) is an art museum in Rotterdam in the Netherlands.

features.name: Oude of Pelgrimvaderskerk

facts.text: A 1761 rebuilding raised the structure by 3.6 metres and added its current bell-shaped gable.
facts.sourceQuote: The most radical rebuilding took place in 1761. At this time the church was heightened considerably (3.6 metres (12 ft)) and was given its present facade with the bell-shaped gable.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The most radical rebuilding took place in 1761. At this time the church was heightened considerably (3.6 metres (12 ft)) and was given its present facade with the bell-shaped gable.

facts.text: Commemorative panels list vicars who served the community starting in 1574.
facts.sourceQuote: Commemorative panels, bearing the names of the vicars who served the community from 1574 adorn the otherwise bare walls.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Commemorative panels, bearing the names of the vicars who served the community from 1574 adorn the otherwise bare walls.

facts.text: The pulpit stands inside a rectangular enclosure where church council members sat.
facts.sourceQuote: As usual in Dutch Protestant churches, the pulpit stands within a rectangular enclosure. Here, the members of the church council sat during services and here, baptism was administered.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As usual in Dutch Protestant churches, the pulpit stands within a rectangular enclosure. Here, the members of the church council sat during services and here, baptism was administered.

facts.text: The oldest bell from 1464 is cracked and now displayed inside the church.
facts.sourceQuote: It has a 44-bell carillon but the oldest bell, which was cast in 1464, is cracked and is now on display in the church.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It has a 44-bell carillon but the oldest bell, which was cast in 1464, is cracked and is now on display in the church.

features.opening: The Old or Pilgrim Fathers' Church (Dutch: Oude of Pelgrimvaderskerk Rotterdam-Delfshaven) is a church located in Rotterdam-Delfshaven, in the Netherlands.

features.name: Prinsestheater

facts.text: Aron Chermoek, a Jewish tailor from Russia, transformed the building into a cinema and variety theater in 1914.
facts.sourceQuote: Oorspronkelijk is het gebouw gebouwd in 1913 als verenigingsgebouw Alcazar, met ‘Concordia Bioscope’ (1914). Er was echter te weinig vraag naar het Verenigingsgebouw, waarna er vanaf 1917 tot 1940 ‘Bioscoop Princes Variété' werd geëxploiteerd door Aron Chermoek, een Joodse kleermaker die als landverhuizer vanuit Rusland naar Rotterdam was gekomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally, the building was built in 1913 as a club building Alcazar, with 'Concordia Bioscope' (1914). However, there was too little demand for the Association Building, after which it was operated as the 'Bioscoop Princes Variété' by Aron Chermoek, a Jewish tailor who had come to Rotterdam as a settler from Russia.

facts.text: Before sound films arrived in 1928, an orchestra accompanied the silent movies shown at this venue.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot de introductie van de geluidsfilms in 1928 werden de films begeleid met een orkest.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until the introduction of sound films in 1928, the films were accompanied by an orchestra.

facts.text: The theater was one of the first cinemas in the 1950s capable of showing wide films.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren vijftig was het theater een van de eerste bioscopen waar brede films gedraaid konden worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1950s, the theater was one of the first cinemas where wide films could be shown.

features.opening: Het Prinses Theater is een theater in Delfshaven, Rotterdam.

features.name: Dockyard V

facts.text: Originally built for Murmansk, the ship was kept by its builders due to World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: Oorspronkelijk waren de schepen gebouwd voor de havens van Moermansk (Rusland). Door de Tweede Wereldoorlog zijn de schepen nooit afgenomen. De werf besloot de schepen in eigen beheer te houden en als werfsleepboot in te zetten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally, the ships were built for the ports of Murmansk (Russia). Due to World War II, the ships never decreased. The shipyard decided to keep the ships in its own hands and use them as shipyard tugboats.

facts.text: Steam service ended in 1978 before the vessel joined a museum collection in 1980.
facts.sourceQuote: De Dockyard V heeft tot 1978 in actieve dienst gevaren bij de RDM, toen het haar stoomtijdperk eindigde. Het schip werd in 1980 overgenomen door het Maritiem Museum Prins Hendrik, net als de Dockyard IX.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Dockyard V was in active service with the RDM until 1978, when its steam era ended. The ship was taken over by the Maritime Museum Prins Hendrik in 1980, just like the Dockyard IX.

facts.text: The vessel displaces 245 tons while powered by a steam boiler operating at 14 bar pressure.
facts.sourceQuote: Afmetingen Lengte: 25,10 meter Breedte: 6,24 meter Diepgang: 2,90 meter Waterverplaatsing: 245 ton Stoomketel Type: RDM Schotse ketel Hoofdmachine Type: RDM Lentz kleppenmachine Kracht: 500 IPK Werkdruk: 14 bar
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Dimensions Length: 25.10 meters Width: 6.24 meters Depth: 2.90 meters Displacement: 245 tons Steam boiler Type: RDM Scottish boiler Main machine Type: RDM Lentz valve machine Power: 500 IPK Working pressure: 14 bar

features.opening: De Dockyard V is een Nederlandse stoomsleepboot gebouwd onder bouwnummer 227 bij de Rotterdamsche Droogdok Maatschappij (RDM).

features.name: Breepleinkerk

facts.text: The original builder, Reformed Church Rotterdam Zuid, ceased to exist in 2008.
facts.sourceQuote: De 'Gereformeerde Kerk Rotterdam Zuid (Katendrecht)', die de bouwer was, hield in 2008 op te bestaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 'Reformed Church Rotterdam Zuid (Katendrecht)', which was the builder, ceased to exist in 2008.

facts.text: A foundation now preserves the site as a war memorial and meeting center.
facts.sourceQuote: Stichting 'Vrienden van de Breepleinkerk en van de Orgelzolder' zet zich sindsdien in voor de instandhouding van het kerkgebouw als ontmoetingscentrum, oorlogsherinneringsplaats en markant punt in het stadsbeeld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since then, the Foundation 'Friends of the Breepleinkerk and of the Organ Attic' has been working to preserve the church building as a meeting center, war memorial and prominent landmark in the cityscape.

facts.text: A cross and the word 'HOSPITAL' remain faintly visible on the exterior facade today.
facts.sourceQuote: Een kruis en het woord 'HOSPITAAL' zijn anno 2016 nog vaag te onderscheiden op de buitengevel van de kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A cross and the word 'HOSPITAL' can still be vaguely distinguished on the exterior facade of the church in 2016.

features.opening: De Breepleinkerk is een voormalige gereformeerde kerk in Rotterdam die in 1931 werd gebouwd.

features.name: Jacob van Gelderen

facts.text: Stolpersteine were placed on Larikslaan in December 2023 and Adrianalaan in November 2024.
facts.sourceQuote: Looslaan 18 19 december 2023: een Stolperstein op Larikslaan 157 30 november 2024: twee Stolpersteine op Adrianalaan 254
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Looslaan 18 December 19, 2023: a Stolperstein on Larikslaan 157 November 30, 2024: two Stolpersteine on Adrianalaan 254

features.opening: De Lijst van Stolpersteine in Hillegersberg-Schiebroek geeft een overzicht van de gedenkstenen die in stadskwartier Hillegersberg-Schiebroek in de Nederlandse…

features.name: Sint-Pauluskerk

facts.text: Construction began in 1941 after Pastor Lansbergen secured the parish finances.
facts.sourceQuote: Pastoor Lansbergen, benoemd in 1939, wist de financiën van de parochie op orde te krijgen en van 1941-1942 kon men een kerk bouwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Pastor Lansbergen, appointed in 1939, managed to put the finances of the parish in order and from 1941-1942 a church could be built.

facts.text: Stained glass windows by Pieter Wiegersma were installed in 1983.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1983 werden glas-in-loodramen aangebracht, vervaardigd door Pieter Wiegersma.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1983, stained glass windows were installed, manufactured by Pieter Wiegersma.

facts.text: Since 2008, the church hosts Eritrean Orthodox services instead of Catholic masses.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2008 worden er in de Sint-Pauluskerk geen katholieke missen meer gehouden. Het gebouw is nog wel in gebruik als kerk, bij de Eritrees-Orthodoxe Kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2008, no Catholic masses have been held in the Sint-Pauluskerk. The building is still in use as a church, belonging to the Eritrean Orthodox Church.

features.opening: De Sint-Pauluskerk is een kerkgebouw aan de Larikslaan 182 te Schiebroek, een deel van Rotterdam.

features.name: TR Schouwburg

facts.text: The third building was destroyed during the German bombing of Rotterdam in 1940.
facts.sourceQuote: The third Rotterdamse Schouwburg was destroyed during the German bombing of Rotterdam in 1940.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The third Rotterdamse Schouwburg was destroyed during the German bombing of Rotterdam in 1940.

facts.text: The current TR Schouwburg opened at Schouwburgplein 25 in 1988.
facts.sourceQuote: The present building of the Rotterdamse Schouwburg was inaugurated in 1988 on address Schouwburgplein 25, 3012 CL Rotterdam
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The present building of the Rotterdamse Schouwburg was inaugurated in 1988 on address Schouwburgplein 25, 3012 CL Rotterdam

features.opening: Rotterdamse Schouwburg is a theatre in Rotterdam in The Netherlands.

features.name: De Nieuwlandse Molen

facts.text: De Nieuwlandse Molen is also called the Van der Knijff mill after the family of millers who ran it for generations.
facts.sourceQuote: De Nieuwlandse Molen of de molen Van der Knijff (in de volksmond zo genoemd naar de molenaarsfamilie die al generaties lang de molen laat draaien) is in de Nieuwlandsche polder een oude molen tussen 's-Gravenzande en Hoek van Holland, die oorspronkelijk als binnenkruier en als grondzeiler is gebouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: De Nieuwlandse Molen or the Van der Knijff mill (in popular parlance so named after the millers' family who have been running the mill for generations) is an old mill in the Nieuwlandsche polder between 's-Gravenzande and Hoek van Holland, which was originally built as an inland cruiser and as a ground sealer.

facts.text: The High Council of Delfland took ownership of De Nieuwlandse Molen following a 1977 reorganization.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de reorganisatie in 1977 is de molen eigendom van het Hoogheemraadschap van Delfland geworden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the reorganization in 1977, the mill became the property of the High Council of Delfland.

facts.text: In 1988, De Nieuwlandse Molen was raised by 5.60 meters to accommodate nearby glasshouse horticulture.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1988 is het windrecht afgekocht en werd de Nieuwlandse Molen met 5,60 m verhoogd in verband met de glastuinbouw, die tot op zeer korte afstand van de molen aanwezig is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1988, the wind rights were purchased and the Nieuwlandse Molen was raised by 5.60 m in connection with the glasshouse horticulture, which is present very close to the mill.

features.opening: De Nieuwlandse Molen of de molen Van der Knijff (in de volksmond zo genoemd naar de molenaarsfamilie die al generaties lang de molen laat draaien) is in de…

features.name: Fort aan den Hoek van Holland

facts.text: The fort's crew captured twelve German soldiers and light machine guns by May 11.
facts.sourceQuote: Het detachement keerde op 11 mei terug met 12 gevangengenomen Duitse militairen en buitgemaakte lichte mitrailleurs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The detachment returned on May 11 with 12 captured German military personnel and captured light machine guns.

facts.text: A coastal battery with forty 15 cm guns was installed in the dunes near the fort.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook werd in duinen een kustbatterij geplaatst met 15 cm lang 40 geschut, dat op 12 oktober 1939 de eerste schietoefening deed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A coastal battery with 40 guns 15 cm long was also placed in dunes, which conducted its first firing exercise on October 12, 1939.

facts.text: German seaplanes laid magnetic mines in the Waterweg on the day of the invasion.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de dag van de invasie legden Duitse watervliegtuigen magnetische mijnen in de Waterweg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the day of the invasion, German seaplanes laid magnetic mines in the Waterweg.

facts.text: The fort stood empty and decayed for nine years between 1978 and 1987.
facts.sourceQuote: Van 1978 tot 1987 stond het fort leeg en trad het verval in.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1978 to 1987 the fort was empty and decayed.

facts.text: From 1989 until 2014, the Dutch Coastal Defense Museum operated inside the fort.
facts.sourceQuote: Van 1989 tot 2014 was het Nederlands Kustverdedigingsmuseum in het fort gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1989 to 2014, the Dutch Coastal Defense Museum was located in the fort.

features.opening: Het Fort aan den Hoek van Holland, ook Fort 1881 genoemd, is een voormalig pantserfort in Hoek van Holland.

features.name: Rotterdams Openbaar Vervoer Museum

facts.text: The name Rotterdams Openbaar Vervoer Museum stands for Rotterdams Openbaar Vervoer museum and Operation of Oldtimers.
facts.sourceQuote: De stichting RoMeO is een organisatie die zich bezighoudt met de exploitatie van oude trams, metro's en bussen in Rotterdam en staat voor "Rotterdams Openbaar Vervoer museum en Exploitatie van Oldtimers".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The RoMeO foundation is an organization that deals with the operation of old trams, subways and buses in Rotterdam and stands for "Rotterdams Openbaar Vervoer museum and Operation of Oldtimers".

facts.text: RoMeO was founded in 1997 by merging several groups previously involved in Rotterdam public transport history.
facts.sourceQuote: RoMeO is opgericht in 1997 en bundelt de activiteiten van verschillende organisaties die zich al voordien bezighielden met de historie van het Rotterdamse openbaar vervoer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: RoMeO was founded in 1997 and brings together the activities of several organizations that had previously been involved in the history of Rotterdamse public transport.

facts.text: In 2023, the collaborating organizations continued operating under the name Rotterdams Openbaar Vervoer Museum.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2023 gingen de organisaties verder onder de naam Rotterdams Openbaar Vervoer Museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2023, the organizations continued under the name Rotterdams Openbaar Vervoer Museum.

facts.text: RET announced in May 2016 that it would abandon the Hillegersberg depot.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 17 mei 2016 maakte de RET bekend afstand te willen doen van de remise Hillegersberg waar de trams onderhouden worden, gestald staan en het trammuseum is gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 17, 2016, the RET announced that it wanted to give up the Hillegersberg depot where the trams are maintained, stored and the tram museum is located.

features.opening: De stichting RoMeO is een organisatie die zich bezighoudt met de exploitatie van oude trams, metro's en bussen in Rotterdam en staat voor "Rotterdams Openbaar…

features.name: Mariniersmonument

facts.text: Prince Bernhard unveiled this memorial on July 5, 1963.
facts.sourceQuote: The monument, a bronze statue of a marine, was made by Titus Leeser and was unveiled by Prince Bernhard on July 5, 1963.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument, a bronze statue of a marine, was made by Titus Leeser and was unveiled by Prince Bernhard on July 5, 1963.

facts.text: The wall surrounding the site lists achievements like the 1666 naval battle at Chatham.
facts.sourceQuote: The wall surrounding the memorial also lists other achievements in the history of the Marine Corps, such as the four-day naval battle at Chatham in 1666, the Dutch East Indies, Korea, Cambodia and Uruzgan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The wall surrounding the memorial also lists other achievements in the history of the Marine Corps, such as the four-day naval battle at Chatham in 1666, the Dutch East Indies, Korea, Cambodia and Uruzgan.

features.opening: The Marine memorial (Dutch: Mariniersmonument) is a war memorial on Oostplein in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Scots International Church

facts.text: A new church building was laid on December 13, 1695, and opened in October 1697.
facts.sourceQuote: On 13 December 1695, there was laid the foundation of a new church, which was opened in October 1697 by Robert Fleming the younger.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 13 December 1695, there was laid the foundation of a new church, which was opened in October 1697 by Robert Fleming the younger.

facts.text: The Scots International Church is also known by its Dutch name Schotse Kerk.
facts.sourceQuote: The Scots International Church or the Scottish Church (Dutch: Schotse Kerk) is located in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Scots International Church or the Scottish Church (Dutch: Schotse Kerk) is located in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

features.opening: The Scots International Church or the Scottish Church (Dutch: Schotse Kerk) is located in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

features.name: Heilige Kruisvindingkerk

facts.text: Twelve granite columns support the wide central nave beneath a 17-meter high roof.
facts.sourceQuote: De nok van het middenschip is 17 meter hoog. Het brede middenschip steunt op 12 granieten zuilen en wordt verlicht door grote rondboogvensters, negen aan beide zijden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The roof of the midship is 17 meters high. The wide central nave is supported by 12 granite columns and is illuminated by large rounded arc windows, nine on each side.

facts.text: The original Odiliak bell was seized by German occupiers in 1943 and replaced in 1947.
facts.sourceQuote: In de toren hangen twee klokken; de 950 kilo zware Odiliaklok en de 675 kilo zware Fatimaklok. De oorspronkelijke Odiliaklok uit 1927 werd in oktober 1943 door de Duitse bezetter gevorderd en in 1947 vervangen door de huidige klok.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Two bells hang in the tower; the 950-kilogram Odiliak bell and the 675-kilogram Fatimak bell. The original Odiliak bell from 1927 was requisitioned by the German occupiers in October 1943 and replaced in 1947 by the current bell.

facts.text: Construction began in early 1926, yet the symbolic first stone was laid months later on a specific feast day.
facts.section: Stichting parochie en bouw van de kerk
facts.sourceQuote: Hier werd begin 1926 mee gestart. Terwijl de eerste muren al gebouwd waren werd de symbolische eerste steen gelegd op 3 mei 1926, de katholieke feestdag van de Heilige Kruisvinding, die volgens de overlevering exact 1600 jaar daarvoor had plaatsgevonden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This was started here at the beginning of 1926. While the first walls were already built, the symbolic first stone was laid on May 3, 1926, the Catholic feast day of the Heilige Crusades, which according to tradition had taken place exactly 1600 years earlier.

features.opening: De Heilige Kruisvindingkerk is een rooms-katholiek kerkgebouw aan de Beukendaal 2 in Rotterdam.

features.name: SS Rotterdam

facts.text: Premier Cruises shut down on September 13, 2000, ordering the captain to dock in Halifax and offload all passengers at midnight.
facts.sourceQuote: She continued to serve as a fairly popular cruise ship out of Port Canaveral, Florida until 13 September 2000, when Premier Cruises shut down. It was midnight when this was made official and the captain of Rembrandt was ordered to dock in Halifax, Nova Scotia and offload all.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: She continued to serve as a fairly popular cruise ship out of Port Canaveral, Florida until 13 September 2000, when Premier Cruises shut down. It was midnight when this was made official and the captain of Rembrandt was ordered to dock in Halifax, Nova Scotia and offload all.

facts.text: The ship was arrested by the Halifax Sheriff's department until the next morning before sailing to Freeport for three years of layup.
facts.sourceQuote: She was subsequently placed under arrest by the Halifax Sheriff's department until the next morning, then days later she sailed to be laid up in Freeport, Bahamas. For three years, Rembrandt was laid up with other Premier Cruise Line vessels in Freeport, Bahamas.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: She was subsequently placed under arrest by the Halifax Sheriff's department until the next morning, then days later she sailed to be laid up in Freeport, Bahamas. For three years, Rembrandt was laid up with other Premier Cruise Line vessels in Freeport, Bahamas.

facts.text: In May 2003, the Rotterdam Dry Dock Company purchased the vessel with plans to return it to its homeport as a hotel ship.
facts.sourceQuote: Then in May 2003, Rembrandt was purchased by the Rotterdam Dry Dock Company (RDDC), with the plan to return the ex-Rotterdam to her homeport of Rotterdam where she would serve as a hotel ship.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Then in May 2003, Rembrandt was purchased by the Rotterdam Dry Dock Company (RDDC), with the plan to return the ex-Rotterdam to her homeport of Rotterdam where she would serve as a hotel ship.

facts.text: The ship returned to Rotterdam in August 2008 after restoration work in Poland and Germany.
facts.sourceQuote: She then moved on to first Poland and then Germany for final restoration. She returned to the city of Rotterdam on 8 August 2008.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: She then moved on to first Poland and then Germany for final restoration. She returned to the city of Rotterdam on 8 August 2008.

features.opening: The fifth SS Rotterdam, also known as "The Grande Dame", is a former ocean liner and cruise ship, and has been a hotel ship in Rotterdam, Netherlands, since…

features.name: Bibliotheektheater Rotterdam

facts.text: The hall accommodates exactly 179 visitors during performances.
facts.sourceQuote: De zaal biedt ruimte aan 179 bezoekers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The hall can accommodate 179 visitors.

features.opening: Het Bibliotheektheater is een theater in het centrum van Rotterdam, gehuisvest in het gebouw van de Centrale Bibliotheek Rotterdam, gevestigd aan de Hoogstraat.

features.name: World Port Center

facts.text: Sir Norman Foster designed this 32-storey structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Sir Norman Foster designed the 32-storey building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Sir Norman Foster designed the 32-storey building.

facts.text: The architect is famous for the Reichstag extension in Berlin.
facts.sourceQuote: This British architect gained international fame with his designs for the London Stansted Airport, the Hong Kong & Shanghai Bank in Hong Kong, the extension of the Reichstag building in Berlin and the 259 m (850 ft) Commerzbank Tower in Frankfurt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This British architect gained international fame with his designs for the London Stansted Airport, the Hong Kong & Shanghai Bank in Hong Kong, the extension of the Reichstag building in Berlin and the 259 m (850 ft) Commerzbank Tower in Frankfurt.

facts.text: ING Real Estate Development commissioned the construction of World Port Center.
facts.sourceQuote: The tower was commissioned by ING Real Estate Development.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tower was commissioned by ING Real Estate Development.

facts.text: Construction costs for World Port Center reached approximately NLG100 million.
facts.sourceQuote: The building costs amounted to approximately NLG100 million.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building costs amounted to approximately NLG100 million.

features.opening: World Port Centre is a 33-storey, 123.1 m (404 ft) skyscraper in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Maranathakerk

facts.text: Since 1997, a massive organ with 25 manuals built by Van den Heuvel has resided within.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk beschikt sinds 1997 over een 25-stemmig orgel van de firma Van den Heuvel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1997, the church has had a 25-manual organ from the Van den Heuvel company.

features.opening: De Maranathakerk is een protestants kerkgebouw aan de Hillevliet in de Zuid-Hollandse stad Rotterdam.

features.name: Villa Zebra

facts.text: A building designed as temporary remained at its first location for several years.
facts.sourceQuote: Hoewel het gebouw oorspronkelijk tijdelijk bedoeld was, bleef Villa Zebra er meerdere jaren gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although the building was originally intended to be temporary, Villa Zebra remained there for several years.

facts.text: Albert Kramer created the rooftop artwork Gibra at the Stieltjesstraat location.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het dak van het pand aan de Stieltjesstraat bevindt zich het kunstwerk Gibra van Albert Kramer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the roof of the building on Stieltjesstraat is the artwork Gibra by Albert Kramer.

facts.text: Children aged 2 to 6 focus on sensory discovery and play rather than traditional art instruction.
facts.sourceQuote: Voor kinderen van 2 tot en met 6 jaar ontwikkelt Villa Zebra programma’s waarin spel, beleving en zintuiglijke ontdekking centraal staan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For children from 2 to 6 years of age, Villa Zebra develops programs in which play, experience and sensory discovery are central.

facts.text: The organization brings its programs to neighborhoods through pop-ups instead of staying only at one location.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarnaast organiseert de organisatie pop-ups in diverse Rotterdamse wijken en biedt zij kunsteducatieve trajecten op scholen aan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition, the organization organizes pop-ups in various Rotterdam neighborhoods and offers art educational courses at schools.

features.opening: Villa Zebra is een kunstlaboratorium voor kinderen van 2 tot en met 12 jaar in Rotterdam.

features.name: Alexander Nevskikerk

facts.text: Architect Leen Waardenburg designed the church with his Russian wife Lilia Gabo.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ontwerp is van architect Leen Waardenburg te Hattem en zijn Russische echtgenote Lilia Gabo uit Sint - Petersburg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design was by architect Leen Waardenburg from Hattem and his Russian wife Lilia Gabo from St. Petersburg.

facts.text: The first post was driven into the ground on September 19, 2002.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 19 september 2002 werd de eerste paal in de grond geslagen en op 13 november werd de eerste steen van de kerk gezegend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On September 19, 2002, the first post was driven into the ground and on November 13, the first stone of the church was blessed.

facts.text: Metropolitan Kiril consecrated the church on June 20, 2004.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk kon op 20 juni 2004 worden ingewijd door Metropoliet Kiril van Smolensk en Kaliningrad, in concelebratie met aartsbisschop Simon van Brussel en België en bisschop Athenagoras van Sinope met aanwezigheid van geestelijken uit Rusland, België en Nederland en gasten uit Sint-Petersburg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was consecrated on June 20, 2004 by Metropolitan Kiril of Smolensk and Kaliningrad, in concelebration with Archbishop Simon of Brussels and Belgium and Bishop Athenagoras of Sinope with the presence of clergy from Russia, Belgium and the Netherlands and guests from St. Petersburg.

facts.text: A dome topped with a cross was placed atop the structure on May 7, 2003.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 7 mei 2003 werd de koepel met kruis geplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 7, 2003, the dome with cross was placed.

facts.text: Alexander Nevskikerk honors the Holy Righteous Grand Duke Alexander Nevski.
facts.sourceQuote: De Kerk van de Heilige rechtgelovige grootvorst Alexander Nevski (Russisch: Церковь Святого Александра Невского, Tserkov Sviatogo Aleksandr Nevskogo) is een Russisch-orthodox kerkgebouw aan de Schiedamsesingel te Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Church of the Holy Righteous Grand Duke Alexander Nevski (Russian: Церковь Святого Александра Невского, Tserkov Sviatogo Aleksandr Nevskogo) is a Russian Orthodox church building on Schiedamsesingel in Rotterdam.

facts.text: Services are conducted in Church Slavonic while main lectures are repeated in Dutch.
facts.sourceQuote: De diensten worden gevierd in het Kerkslavisch en de belangrijkste lezingen worden herhaald in het Nederlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The services are celebrated in Church Slavonic and the main lectures are repeated in Dutch.

features.opening: De Kerk van de Heilige rechtgelovige grootvorst Alexander Nevski (Russisch: Церковь Святого Александра Невского, Tserkov Sviatogo Aleksandr Nevskogo) is een…

facts.text: Peat digging around 1500 created water puddles later drained by windmills and electric pumps.
facts.sourceQuote: Rond 1500 werd er in het gebied turf gestoken, waardoor na verloop van tijd waterplassen ontstonden. Met windmolens werd het gebied weer drooggelegd; in 1914 nam elektrische bemaling het over.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Around 1500, peat was dug in the area, which over time caused puddles of water to form. With windmills the area was drained again; in 1914 electric pumping took over.

features.name: Vroesenpark

facts.text: A portion of the park south of Stadhoudersweg joined Diergaarde Blijdorp in 1940.
facts.sourceQuote: From 1940, the part of the park south of the Stadhoudersweg became part of Diergaarde Blijdorp.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1940, the part of the park south of the Stadhoudersweg became part of Diergaarde Blijdorp.

facts.text: Residents cut down the rest of the park during the Dutch famine of 1944–1945.
facts.sourceQuote: During the Dutch famine of 1944–1945, the rest of the park was cut down by residents.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the Dutch famine of 1944–1945, the rest of the park was cut down by residents.

features.opening: The Vroesenpark is a city park in Rotterdam-North.

features.name: Zuiderpark

facts.text: A major renovation in 2006 removed many trees and allotments to add water storage.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2006, the park was greatly renovated. A number of allotments and many trees disappeared in the process. New water features were created for additional water storage capacity.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2006, the park was greatly renovated. A number of allotments and many trees disappeared in the process. New water features were created for additional water storage capacity.

features.opening: The Zuiderpark is a city park in the Rotterdam neighbourhood of Charlois.

features.name: Museumpark

facts.text: The land once belonged to the Hoboken family who lived in a building now housing the Natuurhistorisch Museum Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: The park lies on the former land of the Hoboken family, who lived in the building that is since 1987 the Natuurhistorisch Museum Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park lies on the former land of the Hoboken family, who lived in the building that is since 1987 the Natuurhistorisch Museum Rotterdam.

features.opening: Museumpark is an urban park in Rotterdam, Netherlands, located between the Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen, Westersingel, Westzeedijk and the complex of the…

facts.text: The estate originated as a medieval manor around 1485 before the current main building was constructed in 1939.
facts.sourceQuote: Het huidige hoofdgebouw is uit 1939, maar de buitenplaats is ontstaan uit een middeleeuwse hofstede rond 1485, die onder meer in handen is geweest van Johan van Oldenbarneveldt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current main building dates from 1939, but the estate originated from a medieval manor around 1485, which has been in the hands of Johan van Oldenbarneveldt among others.

facts.text: Johan van Oldenbarneveldt and later Johan van der Hoeven held ownership of the estate at different times.
facts.sourceQuote: Het huidige hoofdgebouw is uit 1939, maar de buitenplaats is ontstaan uit een middeleeuwse hofstede rond 1485, die onder meer in handen is geweest van Johan van Oldenbarneveldt. Johan van der Hoeven voegde later de buitenplaats samen met de heerlijke rechten van heerlijkheid Tempel bij Rodenrijs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current main building dates from 1939, but the estate originated from a medieval manor around 1485, which has been in the hands of Johan van Oldenbarneveldt among others. Johan van der Hoeven later combined the estate with the delicious rights of lordship Tempel with Rodenrijs.

facts.text: A dedicated exhibition about the estate opened in the historic museum Oud Overschie in 2022.
facts.sourceQuote: In historisch museum Oud Overschie is er in 2022 een expositie aan gewijd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the historic museum Oud Overschie, an exhibition will be dedicated to it in 2022.

features.name: Arboretum Trompenburg

facts.text: The garden sits 4 meters below sea level, requiring a canal system to drain the land.
facts.sourceQuote: It occupies an area of 7 ha and is situated 4 m below sea level, so a system of canals is used to drain the land.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It occupies an area of 7 ha and is situated 4 m below sea level, so a system of canals is used to drain the land.

facts.text: Public access began in 1958 after the site's history extended back to the nineteenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: The history of the garden dates back to the 19th century. Since 1958 it has been open to the public daily for a small fee.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The history of the garden dates back to the 19th century. Since 1958 it has been open to the public daily for a small fee.

facts.text: Visitors can view national collections of conifers, oaks, beeches, and hostas within its grounds.
facts.sourceQuote: Arboretum Trompenburg holds national plant collections of conifers, Quercus, Fagus, Rhododendron, Ligustrum, Rodgersia and Hosta.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Arboretum Trompenburg holds national plant collections of conifers, Quercus, Fagus, Rhododendron, Ligustrum, Rodgersia and Hosta.

features.opening: Arboretum Trompenburg is a botanical garden in Rotterdam, Netherlands, which hosts a large collection of woody as well as herbaceous plants.

facts.text: Jan David Zocher designed the park in its current form during 1860.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park in de huidige vorm werd in 1860 ontworpen door Jan David Zocher.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park in its current form was designed in 1860 by Jan David Zocher.

facts.text: An arched bridge was constructed in 1928 to open the park onto Kievitslaan.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1928 werd ter ontsluiting van het park aan de Kievitslaan een boogbrug gebouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1928, a arched bridge was built to open up the park on Kievitslaan.

facts.text: The historic tea dome on the corner of Kievitslaan and Westzeedijk was demolished in 1957.
facts.sourceQuote: De theekoepel op de hoek van Kievitslaan en Westzeedijk werd in 1957 afgebroken om plaats te maken voor de Parkflat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tea dome on the corner of Kievitslaan and Westzeedijk was demolished in 1957 to make way for the Parkflat.

facts.text: A larger, more famous park lies directly across Kievitslaan from this historic garden.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de andere kant van de Kievitslaan ligt het bekendere en veel grotere Park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the other side of Kievitslaan is the more well-known and much larger Park.

facts.text: The name Staelduinse Bos derives from 'stalen', the stakes used by fishermen to catch salmon in the Maas.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze 'staelvissers' visten op zalm in de Maas met netten en fuiken, bevestigd aan staken of 'staelen', de naam "Staelduinse Bos" zou hier aan ontleend zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: These 'steel fishermen' fished for salmon in the Maas using nets and hooks, attached to stakes or 'stalen', the name "Staelduinse Bos" is said to have been derived from this.

facts.text: Sixteen heavy bunkers and six ammunition bunkers were built in a circle around a central command post within the forest.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf 1942 werden in het bos 16 zware bunkers en 6 munitiebunkers in een cirkel gebouwd met in het midden de commandobunker.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1942, 16 heavy bunkers and 6 ammunition bunkers were built in a circle in the forest with the command bunker in the center.

facts.text: The main path, Oude Hooislag, runs through the long strip of forest starting from the Papedijk entrance.
facts.sourceQuote: De hoofdingang is aan de Papedijk (in 's-Gravenzande) die overgaat in de Oude Hooislag: een pad door de langgerekte strook bos.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The main entrance is on the Papedijk (in 's-Gravenzande) which leads into the Oude Hooislag: a path through the long strip of forest.

facts.text: A side road called Staalduinlaan provides an alternative entry point to this wooded area.
facts.sourceQuote: Een zijingang bevindt zich aan de Staelduinlaan, een zijweg van de Maasdijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A side entrance is located on Staalduinlaan, a side road of Maasdijk.

facts.text: About 850 plant species and 40 trees are organized by family within this compact Rotterdam garden.
facts.sourceQuote: De Botanische Tuin Afrikaanderwijk is ingedeeld in plantenfamilies. Naast ongeveer 850 verschillende plantensoorten, staan er ongeveer 40 verschillende bomen in de tuin.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Botanische Tuin Afrikaanderwijk is divided into plant families. In addition to about 850 different plant species, there are about 40 different trees in the garden.

features.name: Rozenburg Park

facts.text: The legendary Kralingen Pop Festival of 1970 featured acts like Pink Floyd and Santana in this area.
facts.sourceQuote: A major historical moment in the city's music history is the legendary Kralingen Pop Festival, which took place in Rotterdam in 1970 (featuring, among others, Pink Floyd, Jefferson Airplane, The Byrds, Canned Heat, It's a Beautiful Day, and Santana).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A major historical moment in the city's music history is the legendary Kralingen Pop Festival, which took place in Rotterdam in 1970 (featuring, among others, Pink Floyd, Jefferson Airplane, The Byrds, Canned Heat, It's a Beautiful Day, and Santana).

facts.text: The British band Beautiful South recorded a song titled Rotterdam (or Anywhere) about this region in 1996.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1996, the British band the Beautiful South recorded a song named after this region titled "Rotterdam (or Anywhere)".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1996, the British band the Beautiful South recorded a song named after this region titled "Rotterdam (or Anywhere)".

facts.text: The video game Hitman: Contracts features two missions named Rendezvous in Rotterdam and Deadly Cargo.
facts.sourceQuote: In the 2004 video game Hitman: Contracts, the missions "Rendezvous in Rotterdam" and "Deadly Cargo" are both set in Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 2004 video game Hitman: Contracts, the missions "Rendezvous in Rotterdam" and "Deadly Cargo" are both set in Rotterdam.

facts.text: Battlefield V includes launch maps named Rotterdam and Devastation featuring battles between British and German forces.
facts.sourceQuote: In Battlefield V, this city appears in two launch maps, Rotterdam and Devastation, featuring battles between the British Army and the Wehrmacht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In Battlefield V, this city appears in two launch maps, Rotterdam and Devastation, featuring battles between the British Army and the Wehrmacht.

features.opening: Rotterdam ( ROT-ər-dam, UK also ROT-ər-DAM; Dutch: [ˌrɔtərˈdɑm] ) is the second-largest city in the Netherlands by population and the largest by area (319.4…

facts.text: Jan David Zocher and his son Louis Paul Zocher designed the park between 1852 and 1863.
facts.sourceQuote: Het werd tussen 1852 en 1863 aangelegd naar een ontwerp van Jan David Zocher en zijn zoon Louis Paul Zocher.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built between 1852 and 1863 according to a design by Jan David Zocher and his son Louis Paul Zocher.

facts.text: The wooden Norwegian Sailor's Church arrived as a building kit from newly independent Norway.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de westkant van het Park werd in 1914 de houten Noorse Zeemanskerk gebouwd. Het kerkje was een geschenk van het zojuist onafhankelijk geworden Noorwegen aan Rotterdam en is als bouwpakket naar Nederland verscheept.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the west side of the Park, the wooden Norwegian Sailor's Church was built in 1914. The church was a gift from the newly independent Norway to Rotterdam and was shipped to the Netherlands as a building kit.

facts.text: Construction occurred in phases spanning from 1853 until 1900.
facts.sourceQuote: De totstandkoming gebeurde in enkele fases tussen 1853 en 1900.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The construction took place in several phases between 1853 and 1900.

facts.text: The Euromast tower has stood beside the park since 1960.
facts.sourceQuote: Naast het Park, aan de Parkhavenzijde, staat sinds 1960 de Euromast.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Next to the Park, on the Parkhaven side, the Euromast has stood since 1960.

facts.text: Het Park received official cultural heritage status in 2011.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2011 werd het als cultureel erfgoed opgenomen in het Rijksmonumentenregister.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2011 it was included in the Rijksmonumentenregister as cultural heritage.

facts.text: Since 1984 the site has welcomed the public with a focus on recreation rather than education.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 1984 is de tuin open voor publiek en ligt de nadruk meer op recreatie dan op onderwijs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1984, the garden has been open to the public and the emphasis is more on recreation than on education.

facts.text: Seed exchanges with other botanical gardens only began in the 1970s after a post-war slump.
facts.sourceQuote: Na de oorlog kwam die bedrijvigheid niet meer goed van de grond. Pas in de jaren zeventig van de vorige eeuw begon men zich toe te leggen op het uitwisselen van zaden met andere botanische tuinen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the war, that business did not take off well again. It was only in the 1970s of the previous century that people began to focus on exchanging seeds with other botanical gardens.

facts.text: A friendship foundation funds operations and organizes events like concerts and exhibitions.
facts.sourceQuote: Er is een vriendenstichting die bijdraagt in de kosten die de gemeente niet kan, mag of wil dragen. Die stichting helpt ook bij het organiseren van evenementen als rondleidingen, concerten, tentoonstellingen enzovoort.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is a friendship foundation that contributes to the costs that the municipality cannot, may or does not want to bear. That foundation also helps with organizing events such as tours, concerts, exhibitions, etc.

facts.text: The garden spans just 0.54 hectares yet holds a pond, fountain, and heated greenhouse.
facts.sourceQuote: De tuin beslaat 0,54 hectare en heeft een vijver met fontein, een verwarmde kas, een zadenhuisje, een medicinale tuin, een varentuin en een rosarium.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden covers 0.54 hectares and has a pond with fountain, a heated greenhouse, a seed house, a medicinal garden, a fern garden and a rose garden.

facts.text: Botanische Tuin Kralingen features distinct medicinal, fern, and rose gardens within its small grounds.
facts.sourceQuote: De tuin beslaat 0,54 hectare en heeft een vijver met fontein, een verwarmde kas, een zadenhuisje, een medicinale tuin, een varentuin en een rosarium.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden covers 0.54 hectares and has a pond with fountain, a heated greenhouse, a seed house, a medicinal garden, a fern garden and a rose garden.

facts.text: Ruigeplaatbosch takes its name from a sandbank in the Old Maas river.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Ruigeplaatbos dankt zijn naam aan een zandplaat in de Oude Maas.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Ruigeplaatbos owes its name to a sandbank in the Old Maas.
