facts.text: During the Saalian geological period, the Maas flowed via the Rhine to the North Sea.
facts.sourceQuote: De stroomgebieden van Maas en Rijn vielen niet alleen samen toen de Maas en de Rijn na de Middeleeuwen via Rotterdam naar de Noordzee stroomden, maar al eerder, in het geologisch tijdvak Saalien, stroomde de Maas via de Rijn naar de Noordzee.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The drainage basins of the Maas and Rhine did not only coincide when the Maas and Rhine flowed to the North Sea via Rotterdam after the Middle Ages, but even earlier, in the geological period Saalian, the Maas flowed via the Rhine to the North Sea.

facts.text: Nero Claudius Drusus built a dam in the Waal around 10 BC to improve navigation.
facts.sourceQuote: Hoewel de bedijking van de Rijn pas begon aan het einde van de Middeleeuwen, bouwde Nero Claudius Drusus al in 10 v.Chr. een dam in de Waal om de Rijn, die de belangrijkste transportroute was beter bevaarbaar te houden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although the damming of the Rhine did not begin until the end of the Middle Ages, Nero Claudius Drusus already built a dam in the Waal around the Rhine in 10 BC to make the main transport route more navigable.

facts.text: Gnaius Domitius Corbulo ordered soldiers to dig a channel connecting the Maas and Rhine mouths.
facts.sourceQuote: De Romeinse generaal Gnaius Domitius Corbulo liet zijn soldaten een verbindingskanaal graven tussen de mondingen van de Maas en Rijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Roman general Gnaius Domitius Corbulo had his soldiers dig a connecting channel between the mouths of the Maas and Rhine.

facts.text: Roman roads linked Maastricht to the Helinium estuary between Naaldwijk and Den Briel.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook de Maas was voor de Romeinen een belangrijke transportroute, vanaf een fort bij Maastricht liep de Romeinse Heirbaan Maastricht-Blerick-Nijmegen, en via Kessel vervolgens naar het brede Estuarium het Helinium gelegen tussen Naaldwijk en Den Briel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Maas was also an important transport route for the Romans, from a fort near Maastricht ran the Roman Heirbaan Maastricht-Blerick-Nijmegen, and via Kessel then to the wide Estuary of the Helinium located between Naaldwijk and Den Briel.

facts.text: Construction of this port began in the 1950s during Botlek area development.
facts.sourceQuote: De Sint Laurenshaven is aangelegd in de jaren vijftig in het kader van de ontwikkeling van het Botlekgebied.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Sint Laurenshaven was built in the 1950s as part of the development of the Botlek area.

facts.text: Vopak operates tank storage facilities while EBS handles dry mineral bulk transfers here.
facts.sourceQuote: De belangrijkste bedrijven aan de Sint Laurenshaven zijn Vopak met een tankopslagbedrijf en EBS met een gespecialiseerd overslagbedrijf voor droge minerale bulkproducten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The main companies on the Sint Laurenshaven are Vopak with a tank storage company and EBS with a specialized transfer company for dry mineral bulk products.

facts.text: Excavated soil from this port was used to fill the Prinses Margriethaven for ECT expansion.
facts.sourceQuote: De grond die vrijkwam bij het uitgraven van de Amazonehaven is gebruikt bij het dempen van de Prinses Margriethaven voor het vergroten van de home-terminal van ECT.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The soil that was released during the excavation of the Amazonehaven was used to fill in the Prinses Margriethaven to expand the home terminal of ECT.

facts.text: Construction of this port facility was completed in the year 1969.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven is aangelegd in 1969.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The port was built in 1969.

facts.text: The Lyondell Chemical Company operates a factory within these harbor grounds.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier zijn onder meer Districenter Botlek, de Botlekfabriek van Lyondell Chemical Company en de Holland Terminals van PSA-HNN gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Districenter Botlek, the Botlek factory of Lyondell Chemical Company and the Holland Terminals of PSA-HNN are located here, among other things.

facts.text: Holland Terminals, run by PSA-HNN, manages operations at this specific location.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier zijn onder meer Districenter Botlek, de Botlekfabriek van Lyondell Chemical Company en de Holland Terminals van PSA-HNN gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Districenter Botlek, the Botlek factory of Lyondell Chemical Company and the Holland Terminals of PSA-HNN are located here, among other things.

facts.text: Beergat honors De Beer, a former bird island lost during Europoort's construction.
facts.sourceQuote: De dam is genoemd naar het vroegere vogeleiland De Beer ter plaatse dat geheel verloren ging bij de aanleg van Europoort.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The dam is named after the former bird island De Beer on site that was completely lost during the construction of Europoort.

facts.text: Buizengat honors the herring pipes that once used this spot as their home port.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam verwijst naar de haringbuizen die hier ooit hun thuishaven hadden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name refers to the herring pipes that once had their home port here.

facts.text: Before 1699, the name Buysse Gat referred to the eastern entrance to the Haringvliet.
facts.sourceQuote: Vóór 1699 verwees de naam Buysse Gat naar de oostelijke toegang tot het Haringvliet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Before 1699, the name Buysse Gat referred to the eastern entrance to the Haringvliet.

facts.text: Original bridges featured rotating sections to let ships pass through the harbor.
facts.sourceQuote: Allebei de bruggen hadden een draaibaar gedeelte om schepen door te laten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Both bridges had a rotating section to allow ships to pass through.

facts.text: Railway traffic moved to the Willemsspoortunnel in 1994, leaving the historic lift bridge de Hef unused.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1994 werd de Willemsspoortunnel geopend, waarna spoorwegbrug "de Hef" buiten gebruik werd gesteld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1994, the Willemsspoortunnel was opened, after which the railway bridge "de Hef" was put out of use.

facts.text: Dry dock 7 is the largest dock operated by shipyard Keppel Verolme.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan deze haven is scheepswerf Keppel Verolme gevestigd en ligt droogdok 7, het grootste dok van Keppel Verolme.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This port is home to shipyard Keppel Verolme and dry dock 7, the largest dock of Keppel Verolme.

facts.text: The Liquin Terminal TTR and Service Terminal Rotterdam occupy the west side of 2e Werkhaven.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de westzijde liggen Liquin Terminal TTR en Service Terminal Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the west side are Liquin Terminal TTR and Service Terminal Rotterdam.

facts.text: The N471 crosses the waterway via the Tunnel Rodenrijseweg west of Rodenrijs.
facts.sourceQuote: Ten westen van Rodenrijs kruist de N471 de Rodenrijse Vaart via de Tunnel Rodenrijseweg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: West of Rodenrijs, the N471 crosses the Rodenrijse Vaart via the Tunnel Rodenrijseweg.

facts.text: A German magnetic mine sank Lighter 19 in the Nieuwe Maas on May 11, 1940.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 11 mei 1940 deed zich in de Nieuwe Maas, ter hoogte van de haven, een incident voor: Loodsboot 19 liep op een magnetische mijn die door de Duitsers was afgeworpen, en kwam tot zinken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 11, 1940, an incident occurred in the Nieuwe Maas, near the harbor: Lighter 19 ran aground on a magnetic mine that had been thrown by the Germans, and sank.

facts.text: Zevenmanshaven owes its name to the former Zevenmanspolder.
facts.sourceQuote: De Zevenmanshaven ligt aan de westkant van Vlaardingen en dankt haar naam aan de voormalige Zevenmanspolder.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Zevenmanshaven is located on the west side of Vlaardingen and owes its name to the former Zevenmanspolder.

facts.text: Excavation of this port took place during the 1960s.
facts.sourceQuote: De Beneluxhaven is in de jaren zestig gegraven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Beneluxhaven was dug in the 1960s.

facts.text: One terminal here serves ferry routes to Great Britain.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven heeft twee belangrijke functies: hier is de terminal voor veerdiensten op Groot-Brittannië (waaronder een van P&O Ferries) en aan het begin van de haven is een terminal van EBS (de vroegere Graan Elevator Maatschappij) gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The port has two important functions: here is the terminal for ferry services to Great Britain (including one of P&O Ferries) and at the beginning of the port is a terminal of EBS (the former Graan Elevator Maatschappij) located.

facts.text: The Coolhaven was excavated in 1922 to link the Delfshavense Schie with the Nieuwe Maas.
facts.sourceQuote: De Coolhaven werd in 1922 gegraven als nieuwe verbinding tussen de Delfshavense Schie en de Nieuwe Maas.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Coolhaven was dug in 1922 as a new connection between the Delfshavense Schie and the Nieuwe Maas.

facts.text: A Pieter de Hooch Bridge spanning the waterway dates back to 1932.
facts.sourceQuote: Halverwege de Coolhaven ligt de Pieter de Hoochbrug uit 1932.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Halfway along the Coolhaven lies the Pieter de Hooch Bridge from 1932.

facts.text: The Maritime and Transport College keeps its training ship docked along these waters.
facts.sourceQuote: In de Coolhaven ligt het opleidingsschip van het Scheepvaart en Transport College.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The training ship of the Maritime and Transport College is located on the Coolhaven.

facts.text: Construction in the early 1960s required destroying the De Beer bird reserve.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Beerkanaal is aangelegd in het begin van de jaren zestig. Hiervoor moest het vogelreservaat De Beer verdwijnen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Beerkanaal was built in the early 1960s. For this, the bird reserve De Beer had to disappear.

facts.text: The canal features side channels named after global rivers like the Nile and Mississippi.
facts.sourceQuote: Insteekhavens en zijkanalen aan het Beerkanaal zijn: aan de westkant, in Maasvlakte, van noord naar zuid: de Nijlhaven, 8e Petroleumhaven, het Yangtzekanaal, de Europahaven, Amazonehaven, Mississippihaven (met Hartelhaven) en Hudsonhaven, aan de oostkant, in Europoort: de Tennesseehaven, Pistoolhaven, 6e Petroleumhaven en het Hartelkanaal
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Inlet ports and side channels on the Beerkanaal are: on the west side, in Maasvlakte, from north to south: the Nile Port, 8th Petroleum Port, the Yangtze Canal, the European Port, Amazon Port, Mississippi Port (with Hartel Port) and Hudson Port, on the east side, in Europoort: the Tennessee Port, Pistool Port, 6th Petroleum Port and the Hartel Canal

facts.text: The name Prins Willem-Alexanderhaven applies to distinct ports in Rotterdam, Roermond, and Yerseke.
facts.sourceQuote: Prins Willem Alexanderhaven kan verwijzen naar: Prins Willem Alexanderhaven (Rotterdam), een haven in het Eemhaven-gebied in Rotterdam Prins Willem Alexanderhaven (Roermond), een haven in Roermond Prins Willem Alexanderhaven (Yerseke), een jachthaven in Yerseke
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Prins Willem Alexanderhaven can refer to: Prins Willem Alexanderhaven (Rotterdam), a port in the Eemhaven area in Rotterdam Prins Willem Alexanderhaven (Roermond), a port in Roermond Prins Willem Alexanderhaven (Yerseke), a yacht marina in Yerseke

features.name: Waalhaven

facts.text: Covering 3.1 square kilometers, this basin ranks among the largest excavated harbor basins globally.
facts.sourceQuote: With an area of 3.1 square kilometers, it is one of the larger dug harbor basins in the world.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With an area of 3.1 square kilometers, it is one of the larger dug harbor basins in the world.

facts.text: The Dutch army destroyed the factory and airfield in 1940 to prevent German capture.
facts.sourceQuote: The factory and airport were destroyed in 1940 by the Dutch army so they could not fall into the hands of the Germans.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The factory and airport were destroyed in 1940 by the Dutch army so they could not fall into the hands of the Germans.

facts.text: The Koolhoven aircraft factory operated at Waalhaven alongside the airport.
facts.sourceQuote: Koolhoven aircraft factory was located at this airport.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Koolhoven aircraft factory was located at this airport.

facts.text: Post-war damage was so severe that repairing Waalhaven was deemed not worth the effort.
facts.sourceQuote: After the Second World War, the city was prospecting an airport, but the existing airfield at Waalhaven was written off the list because the damage that was caused to prevent the airfield's capture was so great it was considered not worth repairing.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the Second World War, the city was prospecting an airport, but the existing airfield at Waalhaven was written off the list because the damage that was caused to prevent the airfield's capture was so great it was considered not worth repairing.

features.opening: The Waalhaven is a harbour in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: 1e Petroleumhaven was dug between 1929 and 1933 to supply Shell's refinery.
facts.sourceQuote: De Eerste Petroleumhaven is gegraven tussen 1929 en 1933 en ontworpen voor de aanvoer van aardolie voor de raffinaderij van Koninklijke Olie (Shell).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Eerste Petroleumhaven was dug between 1929 and 1933 and designed for the supply of crude oil for the refinery of Koninklijke Olie (Shell).

facts.text: The port kept the name Petroleumhaven until April 21, 1942.
facts.sourceQuote: De Eerste Petroleumhaven - tot 21 april 1942 Petroleumhaven genoemd - is een vooroorlogse haven in Rotterdam-Pernis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Eerste Petroleumhaven - until April 21, 1942 called Petroleumhaven - is a pre-war port in Rotterdam-Pernis.

facts.text: Peat mining in the 17th and 18th centuries created these ponds.
facts.sourceQuote: De plassen ontstonden door turfwinning in de 17e en 18e eeuw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ponds were formed by peat mining in the 17th and 18th centuries.

facts.text: Each pond covers approximately 46 hectares of surface area.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze zijn ieder circa 46 hectare groot en vanaf de Rotte per boot te bereiken via het Berg en Broeksche Verlaat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: They are each about 46 hectares in size and can be reached from the Rotte by boat via the Berg and Broeksche Verlaat.

facts.text: A passage once linked this harbor to the Outer Port before being blocked.
facts.sourceQuote: Aanvankelijk was deze haven verbonden met de Buitenhaven; later werd deze doorgang gedempt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Initially, this port was connected to the Outer Port; later, this passage was blocked.

facts.text: Farmers from the Welplaat polder vanished to make way for this harbor between 1954 and 1957.
facts.sourceQuote: De Derde Petroleumhaven is gegraven tussen 1954 en 1957. Hiervoor moesten de boeren van de Welplaat, een polder ten noorden van Spijkenisse, verdwijnen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Derde Petroleumhaven was dug between 1954 and 1957. For this, the farmers of Welplaat, a polder north of Spijkenisse, had to disappear.

facts.text: The village of Pernis was originally slated to disappear entirely for this port project.
facts.sourceQuote: Oorspronkelijk zou voor de Derde Petroleumhaven het dorp Pernis moeten verdwijnen, maar de woningnood na de Tweede Wereldoorlog verhinderde deze plannen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally, the village of Pernis was supposed to disappear for the Derde Petroleumhaven, but the housing shortage after World War II prevented these plans.

features.name: Maeslant Barrier

facts.text: The Maeslant Barrier appeared in the children's book Mission Hurricane from the 39 Clues series.
facts.sourceQuote: The barrier served as a major plot point for the children's book Mission Hurricane of the 39 Clues series.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The barrier served as a major plot point for the children's book Mission Hurricane of the 39 Clues series.

facts.text: American TV show Extreme Engineering featured the Maeslant Barrier in its Holland's Barriers to the Sea episode.
facts.sourceQuote: The barrier was featured on the American television program Extreme Engineering (season 1, episode 8: Holland's Barriers to the Sea).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The barrier was featured on the American television program Extreme Engineering (season 1, episode 8: Holland's Barriers to the Sea).

facts.text: The History Channel program Modern Marvels included the Maeslant Barrier in a 2006 episode about levees.
facts.sourceQuote: The barrier was also featured on the History Channel television program Modern Marvels during Levees Education (2006).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The barrier was also featured on the History Channel television program Modern Marvels during Levees Education (2006).

facts.text: Neal Stephenson's 2021 novel Termination Shock features the Maeslant Barrier as part of its story.
facts.sourceQuote: The barrier was featured in the 2021 Neal Stephenson novel Termination Shock.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The barrier was featured in the 2021 Neal Stephenson novel Termination Shock.

facts.text: Each of the massive steel arms weighs 6,800 tonnes.
facts.sourceQuote: The arms weigh 6,800 tonnes each.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The arms weigh 6,800 tonnes each.

facts.text: The world's largest ball-shaped joint measures 10 metres across and weighs 680 tonnes.
facts.sourceQuote: The ball-shaped joint is the largest in the world, with a diameter of 10 metres, and weighing 680 tonnes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ball-shaped joint is the largest in the world, with a diameter of 10 metres, and weighing 680 tonnes.

features.opening: The Maeslantkering 'Maeslant barrier' is a storm surge barrier on the Nieuwe Waterweg, in South Holland, Netherlands.

facts.text: The Sint Jobshaven takes its name from the Sint Job Chapel demolished to make way for the port.
facts.sourceQuote: De haven is vernoemd naar de bij de aanleg van de haven afgebroken Sint Jobskapel in het voormalige dorp Schoonderloo.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The port is named after the Sint Job Chapel that was demolished during the construction of the port in the former village of Schoonderloo.

facts.text: Colonial goods were stored and distributed under customs supervision in the Sint Jobsveem area.
facts.sourceQuote: In het Sint Jobsveem werden koloniale producten onder douane-toezicht opgeslagen en gedistribueerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the Sint Jobsveem, colonial products were stored and distributed under customs supervision.
